You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.

Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.

You will be in Stockholm, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.

At McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, tackle real-life challenges across diverse industries, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic understanding of AI and its potential to drive transformation.

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.

  • Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
  • Professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
  • Programming experience (focus on machine learning): R and/or Python (must), SPSS, SAS, Ruby, Hadoop (valued)
  • Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
  • Ability to independently own and drive model development, balancing demands and deadlines
  • Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
  • Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
  • Good presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
  • Willingness to travel

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
⚡️ What We Do

Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.

Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.

🌟Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join us!

👩‍💻 About The Role

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will shape the foundation of Flower’s short-term forecasting capabilities - powering the models that directly drive our daily trading decisions. You will be part of a small, highly skilled team operating at the intersection of data science, energy systems, and close-to-real-time market dynamics.

You will own the full lifecycle of your models - from idea to production - working closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Energy Market Experts to ensure our forecasting stack runs smoothly and is continuously improving. This is a hands-on role focussed on time-series modelling, rapid experimentation, and the ability to translate data into high-impact operational decisions.

What You’ll Do


Build & maintain short term operational forecasting models for energy volumes & prices that drive our trading decisions on a day-to-day basis
Build time series models to understand and explain recurring patterns across different measurements, products and regions to distill signals as features for your next model
Prototype quickly: iterate on simple models, validate rigorously, and scale what works in a dynamic market environment
Own the full model lifecycle: EDA, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and continuous evaluation, supported by our team of DEs, MLEs & Energy Market Experts
Write your models in Python, version your code in Git, use CI/CD to ensure full reproducibility
Partner with DEs to evaluate and integrate new data sources (weather, grid conditions, market signals)
Collaborate & mentor across other data scientists, quants and engineers


Who You Are


Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Physics, or a related quantitative field
5+ years building and deploying time-series prediction models in production using machine learning or classical methods
Strong command of Python and no stranger to the command line; comfortable writing clean, maintainable, production-ready code
Deep understanding of time-series forecasting and real-world modeling challenges
Prior experience in energy markets or power systems
Strong mentorship and coaching skills
Highly driven by our mission and your impact, yet humble enough to know we are all always learning
Eagerness to apply yourself in a mostly automated trading floor environment
Thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt models as markets evolve


📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, Head of Predictions and Optimization, the Team, VP of Engineering and VP of Product.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.

Title: Data Scientist - Vikariat
Description:
Vill du arbeta i teknikens framkant med avancerade AI-lösningar som gör konkret skillnad för kunder och verksamhet? Som Data Scientist på Agria får du en nyckelroll i att vidareutveckla och bygga nya AI-tjänster inom NLP och Computer Vision med målet att automatisera och effektivisera skaderegleringsprocessen. Rollen är ett vikariat på 12 månader, med goda möjligheter till förlängning, i ett litet innovativt team där du får stort inflytande och nära samarbete med både IT och affärssidan.

Om jobbet

I denna roll får du chansen att arbeta i teknikens framkant med avancerade AI-lösningar. Dina huvudsakliga fokusområden blir NLP och Computer Vision med automation och effektivisering som slutmål. Vi använder primärt Python och moderna verktyg inom Azure, där du kommer bidra till lösningar i produktion för våra nordiska marknader samt övriga Europa. Du kommer att ha möjlighet att påverka, driva tillväxt och skapa positiva effekter för både kunder och verksamheten genom smart teknik.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:


Vidareutveckla befintliga AI-lösningar i produktion samt implementera och produktionssätta nya AI-lösningar som effektiviserar och automatiserar Agrias skaderegleringsprocess.
Utveckla lösningar inom bildanalys, språkteknologi (NLP/LLM) och andra AI-tekniker.
Kontinuerligt utforska, utvärdera och tillämpa nya AI-tekniker och arbetssätt.
Utveckla cloud-baserade lösningar med microservices- och event-driven arkitektur.
Utveckla och arbeta i vårt data-warehouse med avancerad analys av konkreta affärsproblem.
Samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam, affärsutvecklare, produktägare och andra specialister på Agria samt Länsförsäkringar.
Delta i tvärfunktionella projekt där IT och affärsverksamheten samverkar för att leverera högkvalitativa och innovativa lösningar.


Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:


Master- eller doktorsexamen inom datavetenskap, matematik, statistik, fysik eller liknande område.
Praktisk erfarenhet i rollen som Data Scientist eller liknande position.
Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av maskininlärning och dess livscykel samt djupare kunskap inom AI, gärna med fokus på Computer Vision, NLP eller närliggande område.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och tillhörande ramverk och bibliotek.
God förståelse för och allmän erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling (frontend, backend, DevOps).


Meriterande är även om du har:


Praktisk erfarenhet av statistisk analys, klassificering och prediktiv modellering.
Erfarenhet från skadehantering inom försäkringsbranschen.


Som person är du självgående och trivs med att arbeta i mindre team där stort ansvar och drivkraft för att leda egna projekt framåt är avgörande. Nyfikenhet och analytisk förmåga är viktiga egenskaper, och du finner glädje i att lösa svåra problem. Förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i nya teknologier och metoder gör att du ständigt utvecklas och bidrar till teamets framgång.

Du har stark kommunikativ förmåga, särskilt när det gäller att förklara komplexa tekniska koncept på ett lättförståeligt sätt för både kollegor och kunder. Att ligga i framkant inom ditt område och att dela med dig av insikter och kunskaper till resten av teamet är något som driver dig.

Kontaktpersoner

Rekryterande chef: poja.daroui@agria.se

Facklig representant Forena: mirek.Swartz@lansforsakringar.se

Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se

Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.

Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.

Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

Title: Data Scientist till Savings Performance
Description:
Har du en passion för att omvandla data till insikter som påverkar riktiga affärsbeslut? Vill du arbeta nära affären och bidra till att utveckla våra sparaprodukter och kundupplevelser genom datadriven analys?

Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till vårt Savings Performance-team inom Investment Center. Här får du en central roll i att analysera och utveckla Sparaaffären genom att kombinera datamodellering, analys och tydlig kommunikation av insikter.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:


Arbeta end-to-end med data – från behovsidentifiering och datainsamling till modellering, analys och visualisering.
Analysera och följa upp Sparaaffären ur ett produkt-, kund- och organisationsperspektiv.
Identifiera mönster i data och omsätta dessa till konkreta, affärsnära rekommendationer.
Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra seniora stakeholders.
Bidra till och vidareutveckla datamodeller som möjliggör bättre uppföljning och styrning av affären.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla dashboards och applikationer i Power BI och Qlik som stödjer analys och beslutsfattande.
Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika team för att driva datadrivna initiativ.



I denna roll behöver du:

Grundläggande krav:


2–4 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist, analytiker eller liknande, med fokus på att ta fram insikter från data.
Stark erfarenhet av SQL och att arbeta med större datamängder.
Erfarenhet av Python eller motsvarande verktyg för dataanalys.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering och visualisering i BI-verktyg (t.ex. Power BI eller Qlik).
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med hela analysprocessen – från data till insikt och presentation.
God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa samband på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt.
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd.
Relevant akademisk utbildning (t.ex. statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap eller matematik.



Meriterande kvalifikationer:


Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller finansiella tjänster.
Kunskap om sparande, pension eller försäkring.
Förmåga att dela kunskap och bidra till teamets kompetensutveckling.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta affärsnära och omsätta analys till konkreta rekommendationer.



Hos oss kan du uppleva:


Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.



"Bli en del av vårt team och...

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt dynamiska och ambitiösa analysteam. Tillsammans hjälper vi Swedbank att bli mer datadrivna och stärker vår position inom Sparaområdet.'' Elias Jakobson, din framtida chef.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-08-31.

Placeringsort: Sundbyberg

Rekryterande chef: Elias Jakobson

Vänligen observera att rekryteringsarbetet kan ta lite längre tid än normalt då det är sommarsemester.

Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.

Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.

Title: Staff Data Scientist
Description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

Are you ready to shape how Data Science influences company direction — not just individual team outcomes? Join Mentimeter as a Staff Data Scientist, a role that exists to help us identify, understand and act on the high-value opportunities where Data Science can shape where the company goes next.

The Catalyst department is on a mission to realise our company strategy and drive innovation, growth and impact across Mentimeter using data, automation and generative AI. In this role you'll turn ambiguous technical, behavioural, product, market and business signals into clear strategic opportunities, decisions and scalable analytical capabilities.

You'll operate confidently where the problem, ownership, approach or strategic implications are not yet clear, creating direction that enables Mentimeter to move from uncertainty to commitment and action. Working across Product Analytics and Revenue Analytics, your work won't just influence team and functional outcomes — it will help leaders make company-level decisions and raise the ambition of the entire Data Science craft.

Success looks like measurable company-level business impact, stronger strategic decision-making, and increased leverage from Data Science across Mentimeter. The strongest work here goes beyond delivering an analysis, model or framework — it changes what Mentimeter understands, prioritizes and decides to do.

What You’ll Do


Identify and frame company-level opportunities where Data Science can create strategic leverage, and connect them to company strategy, growth, revenue, product outcomes and competitive advantage.
Lead complicated and complex Data Science initiatives that span functions or departments — from opportunity discovery and problem framing through to delivery, adoption and impact measurement.
Design, build and productionise statistical, predictive and algorithmic solutions — ML models, recommendation logic, customer and account scoring, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation and causal inference.
Help leaders make well-informed strategic decisions and trade-offs, making important trade-offs visible and helping Mentimeter commit to opportunities that may cut across departments or materially influence company strategy.
Define and raise the standard for how Data Science contributes to Mentimeter's strategy — best practices for modelling, code quality, deployment, monitoring, documentation, automation and responsible use of AI.
Build reusable models, methods and frameworks that increase the leverage of the craft, and mentor data scientists and cross-functional partners to raise the quality and impact of Data Science across the function.
Communicate complex analyses as clear narratives, trade-offs and recommendations that influence decisions across every level of the organisation.



We believe you have


A minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, machine learning or a closely related field, including a track record of leading initiatives end-to-end.
Problem formulation and strategic direction-setting — framing company-level opportunities where the problem, ownership or approach is not yet clear.
Strong business acumen — business sense, domain expertise and the ability to connect the dots between Data Science opportunities and strategic objectives across sales, product, revenue and growth.
Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics and causal inference, with strong proficiency in Python and SQL and solid software/ML engineering practices (git, code review, testing, versioning, monitoring, production-grade code).
Experimentation, measurement and decision science — building forecasting, measurement and analytical frameworks that improve decision quality.
AI/LLM building and emerging-technology judgement — evaluating new technologies (e.g. tools such as Cursor or Claude) and translating promising developments into concrete opportunities for Mentimeter.
Exceptional storytelling, communication and stakeholder management — turning complex, ambiguous information into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders and company leaders.
Company-level influence and craft leadership — creating alignment across functions, mentoring others, and establishing reusable approaches and standards that outlast any single project.
An understanding of GDPR-sensitive data and data processing, with the judgement to know when to collaborate with legal experts on compliance assessments.



Nice to have


Familiarity with modern data tools such as Snowflake, Hex, dbt or similar.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Experience in a SaaS environment — especially enterprise go-to-market, revenue, customer lifecycle, product usage or retention data.
A history of influencing company-level priorities through data science, analytics or strategic insight work.



Not required


Swedish is not required — daily work is carried out in English, and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities.
A traditional cover letter is not required as part of your application.



📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process


Introduction interview
Competence interview, including a live case.
Personality & Logical ability test
Culture interview
References & Offer



What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.


AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.



AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

Title: DYNAMIC PRICING SCIENTIST
Description:
About the role and the challenges you will work on:

Build the Algorithms Behind the Future of Airline Pricing

At SAS, we are building next-generation Dynamic Pricing capabilities that will transform how airline offers are priced, customized, and optimized.

As a Dynamic Pricing Scientist, you will apply Operations Research, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Economic thinking to solve some of the most challenging commercial optimization problems in aviation.

You will work in a highly skilled team of scientists and product managers where your models will directly influence pricing decisions at scale, working at the intersection of mathematics, economics, customer behavior, and technology.

You will also own the science behind our Dynamic Pricing algorithms.


Develop, improve, and deploy Dynamic Pricing models.
Design optimization approaches that maximize revenue while delivering customer value.
Analyze customer behavior, booking patterns, competitive dynamics, and market conditions.
Collaborate with Product Managers to translate business opportunities into analytical solutions.
Work closely with engineers to operationalize models in production environments.
Design experiments and evaluate business impact.
Contribute to the broader evolution of Revenue Management, pricing, forecasting, and optimization capabilities at SAS.
Help define the future analytical agenda of Revenue Management and Network Optimization Science.


The Team

You’ll join a high-performing and diverse team of talented professionals with a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. As our Dynamic Pricing team continues to grow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to its development and help shape the way we work. We value collaboration, curiosity and innovation, and foster an inclusive environment where people support one another, share ideas and succeed together.

To be successful we believe you have

You enjoy solving complex business problems using quantitative methods and have a strong desire to create measurable business impact.

We Believe You Have


MSc or PhD in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
Experience applying analytical methods to real-world business problems.
Strong programming skills in Python, R, SQL, or equivalent.
Ability to structure ambiguity and translate business questions into analytical approaches.
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.


Nice To Have


Experience with Pricing, Revenue Management, Forecasting, Optimization, or Decision Science.
Experience developing Machine Learning models in production environments.
Familiarity with airline, travel, retail, e-commerce, mobility, or marketplace industries.
Experience with experimentation and causal inference.
Knowledge of Operations Research techniques including optimization, simulation, or forecasting.


Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

We welcome diverse perspectives and particularly encourage applications from women.

Additional Information


Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
Desired start date: As soon as possible.
Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work and employment in Copenhagen may also be options, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
To be eligible for this position you need an EU-work permit. Please note that we ask you to inform us if you currently have a valid EU-work permit.

Title: Product Data Analyst & AI Specialist
Description:
Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities


Analyze large engineering datasets to identify trends and issues.
Apply statistical and ML/AI methods for prediction and detection.
Develop automated tools for analysis and reporting.
Support root cause analysis using data-driven methods.
Build and maintain models for yield and failure risk.
Standardize data structures, KPIs, and analysis methods.
Ensure data quality and consistency across systems.
Collaborate with engineers to translate data into actions.
Identify improvement opportunities proactively from data.
Bridge Product Engineering with IT and data systems.


Lead and Manage


Identify improvement opportunities proactively from data.
Collaborate with Product Engineering, WFAB, Backend, Process Integration, and Software teams.
Work independently on analysis tasks; follow guidance from senior engineers and management to align priorities and escalate complex issues. Reports to Senior Manager, Product Operations.


Education & Experience


Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Mechatronics, Electronics, Nanotechnology, or a related field, including a thesis focused on industrial applications and AI/ML.


Skills


Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to solve engineering challenges using data and AI/ML methods; proactive and results-oriented.
Hands-on experience in data analysis, programming, and applying statistical or machine learning methods to real engineering problems. Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience or a proven track record of delivering similar projects.
Expertise in ML/AI methods and working with large datasets.
Experience with statistical tools such as JMP and Minitab.
Programming skills in Python, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
Experience with databases and SQL.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or equivalent.
Fluent in English; Swedish is considered an advantage.

Ensure adherence to Coherent's ICARE values in all aspects of your role:

Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust

Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

We Offer


A dynamic international environment and an appreciative, collaborative corporate culture.
The opportunity to tackle unique technical challenges for the products of tomorrow.
Competitive social benefits.


We look forward to receiving your application!

Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

We are seeking a System Data Scientist to establish and lead Ericsson's analytics function across software development, research, and AI/ML initiatives.

Working closely with the Data Platform Team, you will define system requirements, optimize data pipelines, and ensure analytical infrastructure supports organizational needs.

What you will do:


Learn to transform raw, disconnected information into trusted, ready-to-use data for artificial intelligence and Agentic workflows
Learn AI/ML initiatives including GenAI, LLMs, and traditional machine learning across diverse use cases and business scenarios


The skills you bring:


Master’s degree or PhD in Telecommunication or similar
Experience in driving studies telecommunications or AI technical areas
Experience in presenting technical information to larger Audiences
Python programming for production environments and expertise in managing large data sets and data pipelines
Experience with process in systematization of products
A productive, creative mindset can help you interact easily with other people

Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.

Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.



Bonus points if you have



Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.

Title: Data Science Lead
Description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are hiring a Data Science Lead to join our Data Science Team, working across projects such as Laser Speckle and other Optical Imaging. These roles involve taking novel sensor data streams and turning them into validated, production-ready algorithms with real clinical impact. You will collaborate with Hardware & Optics Engineers, Clinical Scientists, and other Data Scientists to develop prototypes, validate clinical use-cases, and deliver algorithms into production and integrated into Neko Health’s clinics and products.

What You'll Deliver In The First 6–12 Months


Develop, verify, validate, and deploy physics-based algorithms for laser measurement systems, contributing to new product capabilities or research breakthroughs that improve member outcomes (Member-first, always).
Collaborate cross-functionally with optical engineers, hardware developers, and clinical researchers to deliver algorithms that bridge the gap between physical sensor behaviour and production software within Neko Health's clinics and products (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
Deliver production-quality code and integrate physics-aware algorithms into Neko's backend infrastructure, raising the bar for technical excellence across the Algorithm team (Chase 10X, not 10%).
Design and execute calibration, validation, and noise characterisation methodologies for measurement algorithms, ensuring our science meets the highest standards of metrological and clinical rigour (Optimistic Truth Seeking).
Mentor and collaborate within a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, contributing to a culture of openness and continuous improvement.


Requirements


MSc or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant industry experience, or 5+ years post-PhD.
Deep knowledge of physics-based modelling and simulation - translating physical systems (optical, acoustic, or electromagnetic) into code from first principles.
Experience with laser-based measurement techniques such as laser speckle, doppler, OCT, interferometry, lidar FMCW, or spectroscopy or related fields.
Strong software engineering skills and proven experience shipping algorithms to production.
Experience working at the hardware–software boundary: characterising sensors, building calibration pipelines, and validating measurements against ground truth.
Motivated to apply rigorous measurement science to improve preventative healthcare.


Preferred


Experience working in clinical or regulated environments and an understanding of regulatory requirements for medical device algorithms.
Prior experience in med-tech, biophotonics, metrology, or sensor-driven R&D where understanding the underlying physics was essential to getting the algorithm right.
Demonstrated success mentoring engineers or researchers in high-growth, mission-driven organisations.


About The Engineering Team

Distributed and Remote First

We are nearly 160 full time engineers at the company, working from Berlin, Chamonix, Hamburg, Lisbon, Marseille, Vilnius, and Stockholm, spanning diverse disciplines such as Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Electrical Design, Algorithm Development, Machine Learning Development, Optronics Research, Frontend Development and more. We don't expect people to join us with a specific tech knowledge, but we do expect you to work with our tools. We use a mix of React, Typescript, C++, and Python. Our APIs are written in C# with ASP.NET Core, uses Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Active Directory for authentication.

Our headquarters and our hardware development team are in Stockholm, Sweden.

We are a Remote First company; however, it is of course much easier to work remotely as a software engineer than a hardware or firmware engineer (since they require access to hardware or devices occasionally). Software engineers based in Stockholm work maybe one day a week or one day every two weeks from the office.

We meet a couple of times per year to get to know each other and have fun.

Organization and Way of Working

The engineering team is divided into smaller cross functional project teams that each focus on a specific goal or target, where some groups are long-lived, and some are short-lived, depending on how big the goal or deliverable is. We strive to create groups which are cross-functional and able to complete their goals without dependence on other teams, even though this is of course not always possible.

Groups track goals on a yearly and quarterly basis with goal follow-up across the entire engineering organization on a bi-weekly basis. Most groups do internal planning on a bi-weekly basis, but in the end it's up to the group to decide how they want to work.

We have, however, mandated that all groups must present their progress or failures or hacks at our bi-weekly engineering demo, a fun meeting/presentation where we talk about everything from short-circuiting power-modules, how hard it is to calibrate cameras or align polygons in space, to neat new command line tools for operations, a new auth mechanism in the backend, a cool new way to visualize health data or a new feature which helps our doctors be more productive.

We have a flexible workplace that focuses on work/life balance, and we strongly believe in our mission but do not think that achieving it requires sacrificing everything else.

We are looking for a Data Science Pod Lead to join our Data Science team - a senior technical leader who combines deep hands-on expertise with a passion for growing people and teams. This is a dual-track role: approximately 75% of your time will be spent as an individual contributor, developing and delivering production-ready algorithms and ML models from novel sensor data, while approximately 25% will be dedicated to people leadership, serving as the direct line manager and mentor for a pod of data scientists.

You will work across projects such as Laser Speckle Imaging, contactless ECG, Skin imaging, Thermal Imaging, Cardiovascular Algorithms, and Tissue Imaging - turning complex health data into validated, clinically impactful decision support. You will also shape the technical direction and quality standards of your pod, contribute to the broader Data Science leadership team, and collaborate closely with engineers, clinicians, and researchers to bring algorithms and models from prototype to production.

If you are motivated by the intersection of cutting-edge machine learning and preventative healthcare, and you want to lead a team while staying close to the technical work, this role is for you.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months


Develop, verify, validate, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms for clinical decision support, contributing to new product features or research breakthroughs that improve member outcomes (Member-first, always).
Build and lead a high-performing pod of data scientists — providing line management, mentorship, regular feedback, and career development support to help each team member thrive (Tech-enabled, human-centred).
Set and uphold technical standards, code quality, and best practices within the pod, and deliver production-quality code integrated into Neko’s backend infrastructure, raising the bar for technical excellence across the Data Science team (Chase 10X, not 10%).
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware engineers, firmware engineers, software engineers, medical doctors, and clinical researchers to develop and validate clinical use-cases, and support the regulatory readiness of algorithms and models (Optimistic truth seeking)
Contribute to the Data Science leadership team — shaping area-wide strategy, best practices, common tooling, and ways of working alongside other Pod Leads and the Area Lead.


Requirements


MSc or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of relevant industry experience in a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist role, or 2+ years post-PhD in a comparable position.
Demonstrated track record of shipping algorithms or ML models to production in a real-world product or clinical environment.
Deep expertise in machine learning, signal processing, or computer vision, with hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle.
Strong software engineering skills: production-level coding, version control, testing, and integration with backend systems.
Experience working with sensor data, time-series analysis, or medical imaging in cross-functional R&D environments.
People leadership experience (e.g. line management, team lead, or equivalent), with the ability to inspire and develop a technical team.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with comfort operating under uncertainty, making pragmatic trade-offs, and driving clarity in ambiguous situations.
Motivated to apply cutting-edge science to improve preventative and early-detection healthcare.


Preferred


Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. medical devices, IVD, or equivalent) and familiarity with regulatory requirements for medical algorithms.
Prior experience in AI-enabled healthcare, medtech, or biotech.
Systems thinking: ability to design and reason about end-to-end ML systems that are observable, safe, and scalable.

Title: Optimisation Engineer
Description:
About us

Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.




The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.




Watch our film




About the team

At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine to maximise battery efficiency within the grid. We also focus on creating a data-driven culture by building data pipelines and a Business Intelligence layer to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. Our team plays a key role in driving strategic decision-making and overall company success, and we work closely together to ensure a smooth transition of ideas from concept to reality. At Ingrid, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued. We believe in empowering our team members to make a real impact.




About the role

As our Optimisation Engineer at Ingrid, you'll lead efforts in optimising battery storage to support the grid and transition to renewable energy. You'll be key in improving our battery optimisation algorithms, ensuring they operate at peak efficiency. This role requires strong mathematical skills and a mix of optimisation techniques. The impact of your work on our revenue is substantial, with an annual output that continues to grow. You'll collaborate across teams to incorporate diverse data into our models and translate insights into actions.




Location: Stockholm (on-site)




What you'll do

Contribute to the evolution of our battery system optimisation algorithms. Craft and refine them to maximise efficiency and economic performance, leveraging multi-stage optimisation strategies.
Apply your mathematical expertise to real-world energy challenges. Apply deep mathematical knowledge and cutting-edge problem formulation techniques to tackle intricate energy storage challenges using stochastic optimisation, linear programming, and reinforcement learning.
Bridge the data gap. Collaborate closely with your team to seamlessly integrate forecasts and other crucial data into our optimisation models.
Champion innovation. Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by actively contributing to the advancement of our data science and optimisation approaches.
Collaborate to optimise. Work closely with stakeholders to align business goals with tailored optimisation solutions.




Who we think you are

Ideally, you have experience from the energy sector, particularly battery storage or renewable energy systems, and experience in battery optimisation or hydro optimisation is, of course, very meritorious. You have a track record of innovation and a problem solving mindset, in complex, data-driven projects.




Here's what will set you up for success:

Experienced Optimiser: You have proven experience in optimisation, data science, operations research, applied mathematics, or other related field, with a strong foundation in optimisation algorithms and/or machine learning.
Math Mastermind: Solid foundation in mathematical concepts essential for optimisation modeling, including linear programming and scenario analysis.
Technical Expertise: You're comfortable applying various optimisation methods, including linear programming. Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language for optimisation tasks is required.




For this role, we think you have an educational background in mathematics, engineering physics, data science, energy systems, computer science or similar.




Why join us?

At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Nepa is a strategic marketing intelligence and optimization platform with AI built into everything we do — helping iconic global brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt make smarter marketing decisions, faster.




About the Role

As our Senior Data Scientist, you'll lead the analytical design of our most demanding work and act as the main technical point of contact with our clients. You'll set the technical standard, solve the hardest problems, and be the advisor clients trust when the stakes are high. This role suits people who want to set the approach themselves rather than follow someone else's: one engagement might have you designing a bespoke model from scratch, the next advising a client's senior leadership team on what the numbers really mean.

Your Responsibilities

As our Senior Data Scientist, your key responsibilities will include:

Leading the design and delivery of advanced analytical work — Bayesian and econometric models, larger machine learning pipelines, the problems without a standard playbook.
Leading AI-driven product work, including automated marketing mix modelling, our Trinity AI, and Creative AI — our tool for analyzing which creative elements actually drive ad performance.
Driving AI and automation across the team's delivery — and knowing where it genuinely helps and where it doesn't.
Acting as the main technical point of contact for clients, advising them on where AI and analytics create real value.
Supporting scoping and sales conversations, and spotting where the analytical agenda with a client can go deeper.
Setting methodology, tooling and automation standards, and mentoring colleagues coming up behind you.




Your Profile

To excel in this role, you should have:

A degree in a quantitative mathematics or engineering field (an advanced degree is a plus).
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Around 3–6 years of applied experience in the data science and/or engineering space.
Deep knowledge of statistics and machine learning, with the judgement to choose the right method — and know when AI isn't the right tool.
Genuine specialist depth in your area, with the independence to define an approach when there's no template to follow.
Client-facing confidence — you can explain complex methodology clearly and act as a trusted advisor.
A track record of raising the bar for the people and processes around you.
You must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role.
Nice to have: experience shaping or scaling an AI-driven product feature

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd still love to hear from you.




A Few More Details

You believe in the power of data and AI to drive smarter decisions and lasting growth.
You share our values: curiosity that sees what others don't, passion that shows, clarity over complexity, and the drive to care and act.
You want the freedom to grow in your own way, backed by the guidance and support of a close-knit team.
You take pride in delivering the clarity, speed, and impact our clients rely on.




Who We Are

At Nepa, we help great brands grow by turning insight into action. We're building a strategic marketing intelligence and optimisation platform for the AI era — connecting continuous data with sharp analytics, machine learning and deep marketing expertise, so businesses can act faster, spend smarter, and focus on what really drives results.




Our platform brings together Brand Tracking, Marketing Mix Modelling and Campaign Evaluation into one clear, AI-powered view for marketers and the C-suite alike. It's a transformation with real momentum: we're profitable, our subscription business is accelerating, and our AI-driven products are already proving out in the market. Our Continuous MMM tracks what's driving performance on an ongoing basis rather than waiting for a quarterly report, and our new Creative AI has already helped a client uncover a 40%+ potential reduction in cost-per-acquisition by identifying which creative elements in their ads actually move the needle. We're just getting started — for the right person, that's a real opportunity to help shape what comes next.




We're trusted by more than 300 blue-chip clients across 50+ markets — including brands like Fjällräven, Kellogg's and Wolt — and we track over 7,500 brands and campaigns every day. Founded in Stockholm in 2006 and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Nepa has grown into a team of around 220 people across 10 offices on six continents. We're proud to bring clarity to complexity, and to make insight an engine for growth.




Next Steps

We review applications on a rolling basis, so don't delay — submit your application today to be considered for this exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Data Scientist.

Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Sweden - BCG X
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

Our Data Scientists and Senior Data Scientist are part of our rapidly growing team to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, creative, and communicative.

Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills


What You'll Bring

Technologies

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Machine Learning Engineer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role 

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Viaplay, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of our data-driven products and services. Working at the intersection of personalization, customer engagement, and operational intelligence, you’ll design and deploy state-of-the-art ML systems that directly impact millions of users across our platform. 

Your responsibilities will extend far beyond model development. You’ll act as a strategic partner to product, engineering, and commercial teams, translating business objectives into scalable, high-impact ML solutions. Whether enhancing our recommendation engines, uncovering deep user insights, or enabling smarter decision-making across the organization, your work will be central to Viaplay’s continued growth and innovation. 

You’ll join a high-performing, inclusive, and curious team of ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts, and Data Engineers. Together, we foster a culture of experimentation, shared ownership, and technical excellence. Our recommender system already powers engaging user experiences, and we’re only at the beginning of our machine learning journey. 

What You’ll Be Doing 


Design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning models for recommendation, prediction, and classification use cases. 
Own and lead end-to-end ML initiatives, from ideation and stakeholder alignment to development, deployment, and ongoing performance evaluation.
Translate business needs into structured ML problems and deliver measurable, impactful outcomes. 
Build robust, production-ready pipelines and monitor ML systems in a cloud-native environment. 
Conduct advanced statistical analyses to uncover trends in user behavior, content performance, and platform engagement. 
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, content, commercial, and marketing teams to drive data-informed decision-making. 
Contribute to a culture of experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning within the data team. 


What We’re Looking For 

We're seeking someone who combines technical depth with strategic thinking and a curious, problem-solving mindset. 

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: 


Proven experience leading ML projects end-to-end, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment to deployment and monitoring in production. 
Expertise in one or more ML domains such as LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, or reinforcement learning. 
Ability to build ML solutions that are scalable, robust, and explainable, not just performant in isolation. 
Strong experience deploying ML models in cloud environments (preferably AWS) and using containerization tools like Docker .
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow for reliable ML pipeline execution and monitoring 
Solid software engineering fundamentals.
5+ years of hands-on experience in applied Machine Learning within production environments.
Strong academic background in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience with recommender systems, personalization, or content optimization — ideally in media, streaming, or e-commerce. 
Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and production observability. 
Exposure to real-time or near-real-time ML architectures and streaming data systems.


What we offer you


We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 


Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Scania Asset Management
Description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Ventures and New Business at Scania have a key role in contributing to this vision. We drive the industry transformation: At Ventures and New Business we develop complementing solutions to our core and build new growth through ventures and investments. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Scania is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we understand, value, price, and manage electric vehicle assets over time.

This role is for someone who wants to own complex analytical problems, not only build models. You will work with imperfect operational data, commercial tradeoffs, and decisions that matter: residual value, pricing, lifecycle planning, asset risk, and long-term value creation.

Role Summary

You will join a small team with broad responsibilities and close contact with business, finance, product, engineering, and data colleagues. Your work will connect data science with real asset decisions, from assumptions and analysis to model services and recommendations that others can rely on.

Prior experience with electric vehicles, batteries, finance, fintech, pricing, risk, or asset valuation is valuable, but not required. We are looking primarily for seniority in judgement, ownership, and the ability to create clarity in complex problem areas.

Job Responsibilities



Develop models for battery-electric vehicle usage, remaining useful life, residual value, pricing, lifecycle forecasting, and portfolio risk.
Turn data such as mileage, energy usage, battery health, charging behavior, and asset value into clear decision support.
Define, test, and document assumptions around lifetime, degradation, refurbishment, second-life value, pricing, and risk exposure.
Improve, maintain, and operate deployed models and decision-support services used in real business decisions, including APIs, scheduled jobs, tests, monitoring, and versioning.
Communicate technical and financial reasoning clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.



Who You Are

Title: Junior Analytics & ML Engineer
Description:
Since you’ve landed on this page, you already know Hedvig is a mover and shaker in insurtech, and think you might have what it takes to join us. We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.




What about the role?

We are now looking for a Junior Analytics & ML Engineer to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to develop our core data model, creating the fuel for solving complex business problems across the company, and building the infrastructure for our ML / AI platform. With agentic AI we are able to build these cornerstones faster than ever enabling fair pricing, reporting, product recommendations and our customer service bot.




We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by enabling ownership of the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. This role is what makes that possible. Working closely with experienced backend developers, data scientists, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data architecture, ML platform, and Agentic AI development that fuel our growth.




In the role you will:

Architect and scale our core data model, leveraging agentic AI to automate data pipelines, transformation, and ensure high-quality data
Design and build robust ML and AI infrastructure, utilizing Agentic AI workflows to create a seamless, scalable platform for model deployment, MLOps, and continuous monitoring
Drive data and infrastructure projects from project definition to deployed solutions, with full end-to-end ownership
Have the opportunities to design and deploy your own machine learning and AI models, contributing directly to automated decision-making
Be a driving force in our tech evolution by championing your work to stakeholders and always being on the lookout for new engineering trends within AI, the modern data stacks, and Insurtech.




What about you?

The Foundation: You hold a Master’s in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Potential experience: You have 0-2 years of experience working with a modern data stack like BigQuery, dbt and Looker, or deploying ML infrastructure that drives real business value
The Data Foundation: You possess an understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, workflow orchestration, and is fluent in SQL to architect your own data preparation and feature engineering pipelines
Scalable ML Mindset: You are proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, and you understand how to build and maintain a scalable ML architecture to transition from data to deployed models
Production-Ready: You have some experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and embrace MLOps practices to ensure your models are scalable and robust
The Generative Frontier: You have an interest in the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering etc, to accelerate the development of data and ML platforms
The Engineering Advocate: You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous scalable solutions, and love evangelizing modern data engineering, MLOps, and agentic AI




Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.




What about us?

As part of the Hedvig team, you quickly notice that "general truths" are not accepted without being questioned. We're an enthusiastic group of people who love to challenge each other to find the best way forward. We don't care who says something; we care about what's being said. We put a lot of effort into building a trusting culture where freedom, collective thinking, and individual ownership have center stage. We're not perfect – far from it – but we talk about and learn from our mistakes and imperfections to improve continuously. And we have a lot of fun along the way! As individuals, as a team, and as a company.




Come join the Hedvig team, including all of our very loved office pups, in newly renovated offices in central Stockholm.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.

Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.

We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.

About The Role

This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.

Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.

The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers

Some of the things you'll be up to:


Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


So, who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.

You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.

At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.

Besides the above, we believe you've got:


Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:


An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


Some of our benefits:


30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week


About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.

By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.
