Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
In Hearing Care, we are enhancing how data science supports commercial and operational decision-making. As our Senior Data Scientist, you will work close to the business, shape meaningful use cases and help move machine learning from idea to scalable, production-ready solutions.

Making data science matter in business

At Demant, our purpose is to improve people’s lives through hearing health. In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business use data and machine learning more effectively – not as an isolated technical exercise, but as a practical capability that supports better decisions and creates measurable value.

Turn business challenges into scalable machine learning solutions

You will join Commercial Excellence in a business-facing data science role. Working closely with commercial and operational stakeholders, you will learn how they work, understand their challenges and decision-making processes, and translate those needs into clear data science and machine learning cases.

You will manage the end-of-the-end data science lifecycle: exploring and preparing data, feature engineering, modelling, experimentation and evaluation. You will build, validate and continuously improve machine learning models, often in data environments that are imperfect, fragmented or still evolving.

A key part of the role is making sure solutions can live beyond the prototype. Together with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architecture, you will help move models into scalable production solutions and follow their performance over time, including model drift, retraining needs and continued business relevance.

The role gives you the opportunity to help shape how data science is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to shape ways of working, build closer collaboration between business and technology, and build solutions that are practical, governed and adopted in the organisation.

Bring technical depth and business curiosity

You are an experienced data scientist who enjoys getting close to business problems and finding a pragmatic path from data to value. To be effective in the role, we expect that you:



Have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematical Modelling, IT or a similar relevant field.
Bring 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modelling and predictive analytics.
Are comfortable across the model development lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, training, validation, production handover, monitoring and retraining.
Have solid Python and SQL skills and can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-development practices.
Can work with imperfect or fragmented data and identify what is needed to make a use case feasible.
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Are familiar with MLOps practices, CI/CD, model monitoring and production handover.
Have experience working with cloud-based data platforms; we use GCP.
Are fluent in English, as it is our company language.



Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interviews during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare group that offers solutions and services to help people with hearing loss connect and communicate with the world around them. The Demant Group operates in a global market with companies in more than 30 countries, employs more than 14,000 staff and generates annual revenue of DKK 14 billion. Demant is the parent company behind the commercial successes of such world-renowned brands as Oticon, Bernafon, Sonic, Audika, Oticon Medical, MAICO, Interacoustics, Amplivox, Grason-Stadler, MedRx and Sennheiser Communications.

The Group’s products are sold in more than 130 countries where we create life-changing differences through hearing health.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.




Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.




Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.




What We Are Looking For In You:

1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.




Why Join Us?

Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.




Great to Have (But Not Required)

Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).




What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.




Who we are at OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 133 million registered users and 261,000 active partners across 21 countries, have together already prevented 517+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.397.000 tonnes of CO2e!

Your mission

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics and Center of Excellence team at Too Good To Go.

In this role, you will help build and scale data science capabilities across product and business domains, enabling smarter, more automated, and more impactful decision-making.

As a marketplace, many of our most critical challenges revolve around supply-demand dynamics, user behavior, and marketplace efficiency. You will work on problems such as personalisation, optimisation, and forecasting, helping us move from reactive analysis to proactive, model-driven systems.

You will work as part of the Center of Excellence, partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and business teams through high-impact, project-based collaborations.

Your role

Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can drive step-change improvements
Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical methods to solve problems such as: Personalisation and recommendation systems, Marketplace optimisation (e.g. ranking, matching, supply-demand balance) and Demand and supply forecasting.
Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, algorithms, and data products
Design and contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact
Collaborate closely with Product Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders within the Product Analytics and Center of Excellence, working in an embedded, project-based model
Take end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to model development and impact evaluation
Contribute to building data science best practices, tools, and standards across the company 

Requirements

Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, or a related field
Strong experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to product or business problems
Experience in at least one of the following areas: Personalisation / recommendation systems, Marketplace or optimisation problems, Forecasting (time series or causal)
Strong programming skills in Python and solid proficiency in SQL
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing) and impact measurement
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and translate them into structured solutions
Strong communication skills — able to influence product and business stakeholders
High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Title: Data Scientist - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.


What We Are Looking For In You


1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).


What We Do At OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

Title: Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance
Place: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance

Forestil dig, at din machine learning-model er en del af grundlaget for de beslutninger, der træffes i kontrolcenteret for at sikre strøm til millioner af danskere. I Energinet udvikler vi prognoser og datadrevne beslutningsværktøjer, som bruges til den daglige balancering og drift af det danske elnet. Efterhånden som stadig mere vedvarende energi kobles på systemet, stiger behovet for præcise prognoser, avancerede modeller og intelligent automatisering.

Til vores data science-team søger vi en Data Scientist, der vil være med til at udvikle næste generation af prognoser og machine learning-løsninger til et energisystem i hastig forandring.

Bliv en del af vores specialiserede data science forecasting-team

På kontoret i Fredericia bliver du en del af afdelingen Digitale Balanceringsprodukter, hvor vi arbejder med nogle af Energinets mest forretningskritiske digitale løsninger. Vi udvikler, vedligeholder og forbedrer prognosemodeller, der understøtter kontrolcenterets arbejde med at holde elnettet stabilt og effektivt. Vores løsninger anvendes operationelt hver dag og er et vigtigt input til beslutninger om balancering af elsystemet.

Vi er et tværfagligt team bestående af Software Engineers og Data Scientists, der arbejder tæt sammen om at omsætte store datamængder til robuste og driftssikre løsninger. Samtidig indgår vi i et større setup med andre digitale produktteams, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

"Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med reelle og komplekse data science-løsninger i en kontekst, hvor modellerne skaber reel værdi hver eneste dag. Vi kombinerer avanceret teknologi med en vigtig samfundsopgave og et solidt fagligt fællesskab,” fortæller Lene Lindstrøm Olsen, Senior Manager.

Du er med til at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger

Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger, og du kommer bl.a. til at:


Udvikle og forbedre machine learning-modeller til prognoser og beslutningsstøtte
Arbejde med store mængder historiske data og realtidsdata
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste data science-løsninger
Sikre høj kvalitet og stabil drift af modeller i produktion
Samarbejde tæt med specialister, produktfolk og brugere i organisationen
Bidrage til den tekniske retning for teamets data science-løsninger



Samtidig bliver du en del af en spændende udvikling, hvor vi moderniserer vores platforme, udbygger vores arbejde med MLOps og udvikler næste generation af forecasting-løsninger, der skal understøtte fremtidens energisystem.

”Du bliver ikke blot en udførende specialist. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til både de tekniske løsninger og teamets faglige udvikling,” pointer Lene.

Erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller

Vi forventer, at du har en længerevarende uddannelse inden for matematik eller data science. Dertil har du flere års erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Derudover vægter vi positivt, at du har erfaring med:


Python, herunder Pandas og PySpark
Machine Learning og statistisk modellering
Udvikling og drift af modeller i produktionsmiljøer
Azure, Databricks og Delta Lake
Samarbejde på tværs af teknik og forretning



Du er nysgerrig på energisystemer, forecasting og komplekse operationelle problemstillinger, men du behøver ikke at kende energibranchen på forhånd.

Som person motiveres du af at løse komplekse problemer sammen med andre. Du er fagligt dygtig og deler gerne din viden, men du ved også, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Du trives med at tage initiativ og har lyst til at omsætte data science til konkrete løsninger.

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens prognoser?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit motiverede CV senest 6. september. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen. Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale online 16. september og


samtale i Fredericia 23. september.



Er du nysgerrig på din kommende leder, eller har du spørgsmål til jobbet og teamet? Se nærmere på LinkedIn eller ring til Lene Lindstrøm Olsen på tlf. 5363 6193.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Systemansvar, hvis kerneopgaver er at indpasse vedvarende energi, sikre lige adgang til nettene, udvikle markedsdesign, overvåge og balancere transmissionsnettet og at varetage forsyningssikkerheden i Danmark.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

As a Data Scientist and Senior Data Scientist, you'll be part of our rapidly growing team. You'll have the chance to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across a variety of industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, scrappy, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Talented Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Transforming Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills


What You'll Bring

Technologies

Programming Languages: Python

Title: Quantitative analyst for Short-term Automated Trading
Description:
Quote

You will combine quantitative research, machine learning, and software engineering to uncover market inefficiencies and turn them into profitable trading strategies.

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will tackle challenging quantitative problems and develop fully automated, machine learning-driven trading strategies that operate 24/7 and have a direct impact on trading performance.

Your key responsibilities include:


designing, developing, and deploying machine learning-driven trading strategies using Python and modern machine learning/deep learning frameworks
transforming large-scale and high-dimensional datasets into actionable trading signals and predictive models
continuously improving existing models, infrastructure, and research processes to maintain a competitive edge
collaborating closely with traders and analysts to translate market insights into scalable quantitative solutions
staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning, deep learning, and quantitative finance, and taking full ownership of bringing new ideas into production


Meet your team

You will join our Short-term Automated Trading team, where we develop and operate algorithmic trading strategies in the European electricity markets by applying advanced quantitative methods, machine learning, and automation to make better trading decisions.

We are a team of highly motivated specialists with backgrounds in quantitative finance, mathematics, physics, computer science, and machine learning. We challenge each other's thinking, move quickly from idea to implementation, and share an ambition to build better models and make better trading decisions. We value intellectual curiosity, honest feedback, and rigorous thinking.

But enough about us… over to you!

You’ll work deeply with quantitative modelling and machine learning in a fast-moving domain, so you enjoy tackling complex quantitative challenges and turning ideas into measurable outcomes. You are driven by ownership, excellence, and the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled colleagues.

We also imagine that you:


hold an MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related field
are an advanced Python developer with experience building robust, production-quality code
have extensive experience with machine learning techniques and frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
keep up with the latest innovation in machine learning and deep learning, and enjoy turning cutting-edge research into practical solutions that deliver measurable value


Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role. We welcome various levels of experience from a highly analytical environment and will tailor the role to your profile.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Extra time off 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

Senior days extra time off if you’re 55+

Attractive package 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

Share savings the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

Home setup covered paid internet, phone & IT gear

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

New HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Title: Applied AI scientist
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Can you turn rapidly evolving AI technology into solutions that create real value for the people using them?

In Hearing Care, we are expanding how applied AI supports our commercial and operational teams. As our Applied AI Scientist, you will combine practical AI development, rapid experimentation and close stakeholder collaboration to turn business needs into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Make applied AI useful, responsible and scalable

At Demant, our purpose is to improve people’s lives through hearing health. In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business apply AI where it can make a meaningful difference - improving how we work across sales, marketing and clinic operations while ensuring solutions are practical, trusted and built for real-world use.

Take AI from business need to production

You will join Commercial Excellence in a practical, business-facing role. Working closely with business users, subject matter experts and IT stakeholders, you will explore challenges and opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, solution concepts and experiments with clear success criteria and business outcomes.

You will design and build applied AI solutions and continuously improve their quality through prompt and context engineering, retrieval design, chunking strategies and RAG. You will also establish evaluation approaches using golden datasets, automated quality checks, regression testing and human review to understand how solutions perform and where they need to improve.

A key part of the role is balancing quality, speed, cost and risk. You will select appropriate models and solution approaches, implement guardrails and controls for safe and compliant AI use, and work with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architects to move solutions from prototype and pilot into scalable production. You will also provide technical input when external AI vendors are evaluated.

This is an opportunity to help shape how applied AI is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to help shape standards, ways of working and solution patterns, while building practical AI capabilities that can be adopted and scaled across the organisation.

Bring Practical AI Experience And Business Curiosity

You enjoy working where technology meets real business problems and can move pragmatically from an ambiguous need to a working solution. To do well in the role, we expect that you:



Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Development or a similar relevant field.
Have practical experience designing and building GenAI applications, AI assistants, RAG-based solutions, workflow automation or similar applied AI products.
Can translate ambiguous business problems into AI use cases, solution concepts, technical requirements and measurable business outcomes.
Have practical experience with prompt and context engineering, retrieval strategies, chunking, embeddings, vector search and RAG optimisation.
Are familiar with modern AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Instructor or similar tools.
Know how to evaluate AI solution quality using approaches such as golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review loops and automated quality checks.
Can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-engineering practices and are familiar with cloud AI platforms such as Google Vertex AI, Azure AI, Mosaic AI or similar.
Have basic familiarity with MLOps practices, CI/CD, monitoring and deployment of AI solutions.
Can explain AI concepts, solution choices and limitations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and are fluent in English, as it is our company language.



Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interview during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare group that offers solutions and services to help people with hearing loss connect and communicate with the world around them. The Demant Group operates in a global market with companies in more than 30 countries, employs more than 14,000 staff and generates annual revenue of DKK 14 billion. Demant is the parent company behind the commercial successes of such world-renowned brands as Oticon, Bernafon, Sonic, Audika, Oticon Medical, MAICO, Interacoustics, Amplivox, Grason-Stadler, MedRx and Sennheiser Communications.

The Group’s products are sold in more than 130 countries where we create life-changing differences through hearing health.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

In this role, you will contribute by helping our Hearing Care business apply AI where it can make a meaningful difference - improving how we work across sales, marketing and clinic operations while ensuring solutions are practical, trusted and built for real-world use.

Take AI from business need to production

You will join Commercial Excellence in a practical, business-facing role. Working closely with business users, subject matter experts and IT stakeholders, you will explore challenges and opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, solution concepts and experiments with clear success criteria and business outcomes.

You will design and build applied AI solutions and continuously improve their quality through prompt and context engineering, retrieval design, chunking strategies and RAG. You will also establish evaluation approaches using golden datasets, automated quality checks, regression testing and human review to understand how solutions perform and where they need to improve.

A key part of the role is balancing quality, speed, cost and risk. You will select appropriate models and solution approaches, implement guardrails and controls for safe and compliant AI use, and work with MLOps, Data Engineers and Architects to move solutions from prototype and pilot into scalable production. You will also provide technical input when external AI vendors are evaluated.

This is an opportunity to help shape how applied AI is used across Hearing Care. As our AI maturity develops, you will have room to help shape standards, ways of working and solution patterns, while building practical AI capabilities that can be adopted and scaled across the organisation.

Bring Practical AI Experience And Business Curiosity

You enjoy working where technology meets real business problems and can move pragmatically from an ambiguous need to a working solution. To do well in the role, we expect that you:


  • Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Development or a similar relevant field.
  • Have practical experience designing and building GenAI applications, AI assistants, RAG-based solutions, workflow automation or similar applied AI products.
  • Can translate ambiguous business problems into AI use cases, solution concepts, technical requirements and measurable business outcomes.
  • Have practical experience with prompt and context engineering, retrieval strategies, chunking, embeddings, vector search and RAG optimisation.
  • Are familiar with modern AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Instructor or similar tools.
  • Know how to evaluate AI solution quality using approaches such as golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review loops and automated quality checks.
  • Can write clean, maintainable code aligned with good software-engineering practices and are familiar with cloud AI platforms such as Google Vertex AI, Azure AI, Mosaic AI or similar.
  • Have basic familiarity with MLOps practices, CI/CD, monitoring and deployment of AI solutions.
  • Can explain AI concepts, solution choices and limitations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and are fluent in English, as it is our company language.


Want to join us?

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than August 31th, 2026. We will conduct 1st and 2nd interview during September. If you would like to know more about the position, you may contact, Manager, Sophia Evtimova on email at sovm@demant.com.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare group that offers solutions and services to help people with hearing loss connect and communicate with the world around them. The Demant Group operates in a global market with companies in more than 30 countries, employs more than 14,000 staff and generates annual revenue of DKK 14 billion. Demant is the parent company behind the commercial successes of such world-renowned brands as Oticon, Bernafon, Sonic, Audika, Oticon Medical, MAICO, Interacoustics, Amplivox, Grason-Stadler, MedRx and Sennheiser Communications.

The Group’s products are sold in more than 130 countries where we create life-changing differences through hearing health.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Real-World Data Science Manager
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Real-World Evidence (RWE) Søborg, Denmark or London, United Kingdom

Do you want to use advanced statistical methods and real-world healthcare data to influence clinical development across a global pharmaceutical pipeline? Are you excited by solving complex scientific questions, developing innovative analytical approaches, and generating evidence that drives decisions throughout drug development? If so, this could be your opportunity to join a highly scientific and collaborative environment where your work can make a meaningful impact.

Your new role

As a Real-World Data Science Manager, you will join the Real-World Evidence team within Clinical Evidence & Insights (CE&I). Working alongside data scientists, epidemiologists, clinicians, and development teams, you will generate high-quality evidence from real-world data to support clinical development decisions across Novo Nordisk's portfolio.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Applying advanced statistical methods and analytical approaches to generate evidence from large and complex healthcare datasets.
Designing and implementing observational studies and other real-world evidence initiatives that address clinically relevant questions.
Developing analysis-ready datasets by integrating, transforming, and quality-assuring data from diverse real-world sources, including electronic health records, registries, claims databases, and external partnerships.
Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to translate scientific questions into robust analytical solutions and evidence plans that support clinical development.
Communicating complex analytical findings through presentations, reports, publications, and discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.


You will also contribute to the development of innovative analytical methods, reproducible workflows, and statistical best practices that strengthen evidence generation across the organisation.

Your new department

You will join Real-World Evidence within Clinical Evidence & Insights, part of Medical & Translational Sciences in Research & Development. The team plays a key role in supporting clinical development by generating fit-for-purpose evidence from real-world data that helps shape clinical programmes and accelerate the pipeline. You will become part of a highly engaged, multidisciplinary team of epidemiologists and data scientists based across Denmark and the UK, working together to influence important development decisions and advance scientific understanding.

Your Skills And Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have a strong quantitative background combined with hands-on experience working with real-world healthcare data and advanced analytics.

We Are Particularly Interested In Candidates Who Have


An MSc degree or equivalent within Biostatistics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Physics, or another quantitative discipline.
Strong expertise in statistical modelling, causal inference, survival analysis, longitudinal data analysis, and related advanced analytical methods.
Experience working with real-world healthcare data, including registries, electronic health records, claims databases, or observational studies.
Excellent programming skills in R or Python, combined with experience using SQL, Git, and reproducible analytical workflows.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex statistical concepts to multidisciplinary stakeholders.
A PhD, experience within the pharmaceutical industry, and knowledge of modern causal inference methods such as target trial emulation will be considered an advantage.


Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 DKK to 956,900 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline

30 August 2026. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Title: Commercial AI & Data Lead - Aurocon
Description:
Kan du omsætte data fra Aurocons intelligente IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder til konkrete produkter, bedre beslutningsgrundlag og nye kommercielle muligheder?




Fra IoT-data til produktudvikling og forretningsmuligheder




Aurocons voksende base af IoT-forbundne Aurotrap-enheder genererer store mængder data om blandt andet hændelser, sensoraktivitet, connectivity, batteri, drift og installationer. Som ansvarlig for AI & Data bringer du disse data i spil.




Stillingen kombinerer strategi med hands-on udvikling, og særligt i starten er du selv den tekniske drivkraft. Du analyserer data, skriver kode, bygger prototyper og dokumenterer, hvor AI og machine learning kan skabe reel kunde- og forretningsværdi.




Dit ansvar omfatter blandt andet at:

kombinere IoT- og tidsseriedata med produktdata, historiske hændelser, supportviden og teknisk dokumentation
skabe struktur, kvalitet og en skalerbar arkitektur omkring virksomhedens datagrundlag
udvikle machine-learning-løsninger til analyse, anomalidetektion, klassifikation og prædiktion
definere og implementere Aurocons AI- og datastrategi
udvikle fundamentet for en modeluafhængig Aurocon AI Engine baseret på egne data og domæneviden
identificere nye AI- og dataprodukter, der øger værdien af Aurotrap-platformen og kan skabe recurring revenue
arbejde hands-on med LLM'er, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, function calling og AI-agenter
udvikle proof-of-concepts og bringe de rigtige løsninger fra prototype til produktion sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet




Du refererer direkte til CEO, arbejder tæt sammen med CTO og udviklingsteamet og kommunikerer med både kunder og kommercielle samarbejdspartnere. CTO har ansvaret for hardware, embedded software, firmware og den tekniske produktplatform, mens du får ejerskab for data, analytics, machine learning og AI.




Teknisk builder med blik for produkt og forretning




Du er enten Head of AI i dag eller er klar til dit næste karriereskridt fra din nuværende position som AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Lead eller tilsvarende. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.




Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
function calling og AI-agenter
API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.




Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.




Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.




Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.




Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.




En spændende karrieremulighed




Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.




I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.




Om Aurocon




Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.




Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.




Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, evne til selv at bygge løsninger og din ambition om med tiden at tage et strategisk og ledelsesmæssigt ansvar.


Du har solid erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

  • Data Science, Machine Learning og generativ AI
  • Python, SQL, data engineering og større datamængder
  • LLM-arkitektur, RAG, embeddings og vector databases
  • function calling og AI-agenter
  • API-integrationer, model deployment og MLOps/LLMOps
  • cloud-, data- og analyticsarkitektur.


Kendskab til f.eks. Qwen, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face eller vLLM er relevant. Du er ikke bundet til én teknologistak, men har en pragmatisk tilgang til teknologi og vurderer modeller og løsninger ud fra kvalitet, økonomi, latency, sikkerhed, GDPR, skalerbarhed og den konkrete forretningsværdi.


Derudover har du erfaring med IoT, tidsseriedata, hardware-enabled software og operationelle eventdata.


Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og selvkørende og trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er defineret på forhånd.


Din tekniske faglighed kombinerer du med et produkt- og forretningsorienteret mindset, der gør dig i stand til at prioritere muligheder ud fra kundeværdi, betalingsvillighed, differentiering, udviklingsomkostninger og skalerbarhed.


En spændende karrieremulighed


Du får en sjælden mulighed for at bygge et strategisk vigtigt område fra bunden. Aurocon har allerede de fysiske produkter, en international installeret base og et voksende datasæt fra enheder i virkelige miljøer. Ambitionen er, at data og AI bliver en central del af virksomhedens næste produktgeneration og langsigtede konkurrenceevne.


I takt med at området vokser, får du mulighed for at opbygge og lede et AI- og datateam. For den rette profil kan stillingen derfor blive et markant karriereskridt fra teknisk specialist til leder med et bredere strategisk teknologiansvar.


Om Aurocon


Auroconudvikler og producerer avancerede løsninger til skadedyrsbekæmpelse baseret på banebrydende teknologi.


Flagskibsproduktet The Aurotrap med tilhørende IT platform og mobil app, er en IoT baseret intelligent, giftfri multi-kill rottefælde, som gør det muligt at overvåge og håndtere rotteaktivitet i realtid.


Fra hovedsædet i Aalborg opererer Aurocon.io på internationale markeder og leverer løsninger, der forbedrer både operationel effektivitet og miljømæssig bæredygtighed.

Title: AI-specialist inden for sprogmodeller og generativ AI
Place: Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at forme næste generation af AI-løsninger i dansk erhvervsliv og opbygge skalerbare systemer baseret på LLM, RAG og agentisk AI?

Teknologisk Institut søger en stærk og nysgerrig AI-specialist til sektionen Dataanvendelse i Taastrup. Vi oplever en stigende efterspørgsel på værdiskabende AI-applikationer og ønsker at udvide vores kapacitet inden for sprogmodeller, RAG, fine-tuning og agentiske AI-systemer. Du får en nøglerolle i at rådgive virksomheder, afdække nye teknologiske muligheder og omsætte avanceret AI til driftssikre løsninger med reel forretningsværdi.

Praktisk AI-udvikling med direkte forretningsværdi

I denne rolle bliver du en drivkraft i at bygge bro mellem den nyeste AI-forskning og kommerciel anvendelse. Din primære opgave bliver at designe, implementere og optimere sprogmodelbaserede arkitekturer. Det daglige arbejde spænder bredt - fra datapræparering, retrieval og modeltilpasning til evaluering, API-integration og deployment i lokale eller cloudbaserede miljøer.

Selvom sprogmodeller udgør dit kernefokus, vil du også indgå i sektionens øvrige AI- og data science-projekter, som blandt andet omfatter billed- og videoanalyse.

Dine Primære Opgaver Bliver At


Udvikle løsninger baseret på sprogmodeller, RAG-arkitekturer, fine-tuning og agentiske systemer
Afvikle og teste modeller på vores lokale GPU-infrastruktur (SLURM) samt i skyen og hybride opsætninger
Rådgive kunder og drive tekniske forløb fra indledende behovsafklaring og arkitekturdesign til endelig aflevering
Identificere nye anvendelsesmuligheder, opbygge projektidéer samt bidrage til fondsansøgninger og kommercielle tilbud
Sparre på tværs af sektionen om projekter inden for computer vision, billedanalyse og procesoptimering


Du træder ind i en stilling med betydeligt fagligt råderum og kort vej fra idé til handling. Vi råder over en moderne digital infrastruktur med lokal GPU-hardware, hvilket giver dig ideelle betingelser for at eksperimentere, bygge og teste komplekse modeller. Du bliver en del af et specialiseret team i Taastrup, hvor vi lægger vægt på høj faglig kvalitet, videndeling og løsninger, der gør en målbar forskel for vores kunder.

Stærk teknisk AI-profil med blik for praktisk anvendelse

Du har en kandidatgrad eller ph.d. inden for et relevant teknisk område (f.eks. datalogi, AI, softwareudvikling, data science eller ingeniørvidenskab) samt dokumenteret erfaring med at nå helt i mål med sprogmodelbaserede applikationer.

Vi forventer, at du har stærke kompetencer inden for flere af følgende områder:


Sprogmodeller, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering og systematisk modelevaluering
Python og moderne softwareudvikling (Git, CI/CD, test og kodestruktur)
Linux-miljøer, Docker-containerisering samt MLOps / ML-DevOps
Modeldeployment på tværs af on-premise, cloud- og hybridinfrastruktur
Håndtering af GPU-ressourcer og modeloptimering


Erfaring med kundevendte tekniske forløb eller fondsansøgninger er en klar fordel. Som person arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt med en naturlig lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye teknologier. Du er god til at forklare komplekse tekniske valg på en letforståelig måde over for kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af Teknologisk Institut

Hos Teknologisk Institut bliver du en del af en stærk tværfaglig organisation, hvor vi arbejder med at bringe ny teknologi i anvendelse i virksomheder og samfund.

Du bliver en del af centeret Bæredygtighed og Digitalisering og tilknyttes sektionen Dataanvendelse i Taastrup. Her arbejder vi i feltet mellem avanceret sensorteknologi, data science, anvendt AI og digitale løsninger på tværs af brancher. Centerets ambition er at være den førende innovationspartner for digitale og teknologiske løsninger, hvor vi blandt andet udnytter komplekse data og fysiske målesystemer til at optimere alt fra industrielle processer til kvalitet og bæredygtighed i fødevaresektoren.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Kristian Gregersen på tlf. 7220 1282.

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via vores rekrutteringssystem senest den 15. september 2026.

Title: ML Research Engineer / Scientist
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ML Research Engineer / Scientist based in Denmark.

Join a research-driven team building next-generation AI models designed to understand complete CT studies rather than isolated findings.

You’ll work on foundation models, vision-language learning, and multi-finding detection using medical imaging data at unprecedented scale.

Your research will have a direct path from experimentation to regulatory submissions, hospital deployment, and real-world patient care.

You’ll own models and experiments end to end, from developing the initial idea through training, evaluation, calibration, and production readiness.

You’ll work alongside experienced ML engineers, software engineers, and fellowship-trained radiologists across multiple clinical specialties.

The role combines deep technical research with practical impact, giving you the opportunity to solve challenging problems in medical AI with exceptionally rich real-world data.

This is a fully remote opportunity for an independent researcher who wants their work to move quickly from the lab into clinical practice.

Accountabilities


Design, develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models capable of interpreting complete CT studies at the study level.
Research foundation-model approaches for medical imaging, including 3D and volumetric learning at large scale.
Develop and investigate vision-language models that connect medical images with the terminology and reporting patterns used by radiologists.
Build models capable of identifying and prioritizing multiple urgent clinical findings simultaneously while maintaining safe and clinically appropriate operating points.
Design and execute independent experiments, from hypothesis formation and architecture selection through training, evaluation, and analysis.
Develop custom architectures, training pipelines, loss functions, and distributed training approaches using modern deep learning frameworks.
Analyze model performance rigorously and establish reproducible evaluation methodologies suitable for clinically consequential AI systems.
Work closely with fellowship-trained radiologists to understand clinical requirements, interpret results, and translate research findings into practical model improvements.
Contribute to models and research that progress toward regulatory submissions, clinical deployment, and real-world patient use.
Take ownership of research projects end to end and make informed decisions about which experiments and approaches are most likely to deliver meaningful improvements.
Collaborate with ML and software engineering teams to move successful research from experimentation toward robust, deployable systems.


Requirements


Strong practical experience with modern machine learning and deep learning, particularly using PyTorch for custom architectures, training loops, and experimentation.
Deep understanding of why machine learning architectures, objectives, optimization strategies, and training approaches work, rather than relying solely on existing implementations.
Demonstrated ability to independently formulate hypotheses, design experiments, interpret results, and iterate toward better models.
Strong understanding of rigorous experimentation, evaluation, reproducibility, and model validation.
Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed training environments is highly valuable.
A strong interest in solving technically challenging problems where model performance and reliability have meaningful real-world consequences.
Ability to work effectively with researchers, engineers, and clinical experts in a collaborative environment.
Medical imaging, 3D computer vision, or volumetric-data experience is advantageous but not required.
Experience with vision-language models or self-supervised learning is a plus.
Familiarity with DICOM, CT imaging, radiology, or other medical-data formats and workflows is beneficial.
A PhD, research publications, or a strong academic research background is a plus, but not a prerequisite.
Prior medical-AI experience is not required; a willingness to learn clinical concepts directly from radiology experts is valued.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.


Benefits


Fully remote position open to candidates worldwide.
Location-flexible compensation with a cash-weighted base salary determined according to the local market in the country where you work.
Specific compensation range for your location shared early in the hiring process.
No equity included in international offers, with compensation structured transparently around local-market cash pay.
Opportunity to work with a real-world CT dataset covering approximately 10 million patients, paired with radiology reports.
Direct collaboration with fellowship-trained radiologists across areas including chest, body, MSK, neuro, and oncology.
Opportunity to work on research that can progress from experimentation to FDA submissions, hospital deployments, and patient care within months.
Exposure to large-scale foundation models, vision-language learning, distributed training, medical imaging, and clinically focused AI evaluation.
High degree of ownership over research ideas, experiments, models, and technical direction.
Opportunity to work alongside researchers and engineers with significant contributions to medical AI, open datasets, algorithms, and clinical AI systems.
A small, research-oriented team where successful ideas can move quickly from research into production.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Biostatistician and Statistical Programmer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Application deadline: 23/08/2026

Location: Ballerup 2750, Denmark, Denmark

Contract type: Permanent

Job ID: 4095

Role Description

Use your expertise in both biostatistics and statistical programming to shape evidence that supports better decisions for patients, healthcare systems, and science. In this role, you will work across clinical development, publications, and market access, applying your skills where they can create clear and visible impact. If you are looking for a position that offers variety, scientific depth, and the opportunity to work beyond a traditional specialist track, this could be the right next step for you.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines. This is a unique opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one highly impactful role, working across clinical development, publications, and market access in a way that offers both variety and visibility.

Your role

As our new Biostatistician & Statistical Programmer, you will play a key role in generating robust evidence from Phase 2b, Phase 3, and Phase 4 clinical trials, as well as non-interventional studies and external data sources. This is a broad and hands-on role where you will combine statistical thinking with programming expertise to support publication activities, pricing and reimbursement discussions, and evidence generation across our portfolio.

Perform biostatistical analyses and statistical programming for publication-related analysis requests, including abstracts and manuscripts
Conduct subgroup analyses to support affiliate pricing and reimbursement negotiations
Provide programming and statistical input to HTA and payer-related deliverables
Program, quality control, and document datasets, tables, figures, and listings
Contribute statistical guidance for meta-analyses and indirect treatment comparisons, including network meta-analysis and population-adjustment methods based on patient-level data


The role offers a rare opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one position with broad scientific impact, working across diverse data sources including clinical trial, real-world, and external database evidence. You will contribute directly to publications, market access, and evidence-generation activities while joining a collaborative international environment with strong technical peers.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline
Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or a related field
Strong practical expertise in SAS (familiarity with R will be an added value)
Experience with CDISC standards, including ADaM and SDTM, and familiarity with relevant regulatory guidelines
Experience with statistical analysis in clinical trials, and preferably also meta-analysis or indirect treatment comparison methods


LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and a self-driven, flexible, and supportive mindset, along with the ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration and a fast-paced environment?

Your new team

You will join the Real World Evidence DA & COA department within Global Clinical Development, where we work at the intersection of biostatistics, real-world evidence, and clinical outcome assessment. The team collaborates closely across projects and functions to deliver high-quality analyses that support both scientific and business decisions. In this role, your main interfaces will be with fellow biostatisticians and statistical programmers, with occasional collaboration across Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access.

Your application

For additional information, please contact Niels Hoejsager Bennike, Head of Real World Evidence, DA and COA at NHBDK@leo-pharma.com.

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Beyond the skin

Become part of LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. We are the legacy-builders of the future – enabling people to have a better today and tomorrow. With the world as our lab, we are transforming innovative ideas into more effective and easier-to-use medicines. Through collaboration and partnerships, we can do much more.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a fundamental difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.
