As our new Biostatistician & Statistical Programmer, you will play a key role in generating robust evidence from Phase 2b, Phase 3, and Phase 4 clinical trials, as well as non-interventional studies and external data sources. This is a broad and hands-on role where you will combine statistical thinking with programming expertise to support publication activities, pricing and reimbursement discussions, and evidence generation across our portfolio.
  • Perform biostatistical analyses and statistical programming for publication-related analysis requests, including abstracts and manuscripts
  • Conduct subgroup analyses to support affiliate pricing and reimbursement negotiations
  • Provide programming and statistical input to HTA and payer-related deliverables
  • Program, quality control, and document datasets, tables, figures, and listings
  • Contribute statistical guidance for meta-analyses and indirect treatment comparisons, including network meta-analysis and population-adjustment methods based on patient-level data

The role offers a rare opportunity to combine biostatistics and statistical programming in one position with broad scientific impact, working across diverse data sources including clinical trial, real-world, and external database evidence. You will contribute directly to publications, market access, and evidence-generation activities while joining a collaborative international environment with strong technical peers.

Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:
  • MSc or PhD in Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline
  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or a related field
  • Strong practical expertise in SAS (familiarity with R will be an added value)
  • Experience with CDISC standards, including ADaM and SDTM, and familiarity with relevant regulatory guidelines
  • Experience with statistical analysis in clinical trials, and preferably also meta-analysis or indirect treatment comparison methods

LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and a self-driven, flexible, and supportive mindset, along with the ability to thrive in cross-functional collaboration and a fast-paced environment?

Your new team

You will join the Real World Evidence DA & COA department within Global Clinical Development, where we work at the intersection of biostatistics, real-world evidence, and clinical outcome assessment. In this role, your main interfaces will be with fellow biostatisticians and statistical programmers, with occasional collaboration across Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access.

Your application

For additional information, please contact Niels Hoejsager Bennike, Head of Real World Evidence, DA and COA at NHBDK@leo-pharma.com.

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Title: Data Analytics Lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Please note: This is a full-time office-based role (5 days/week).




About the Role

As a Platform Data Analyst, you will own analytical workstreams end-to-end — from scoping and data modelling through to communicating findings and driving stakeholder action. You will work with large, complex datasets spanning customer orders, supplier transactions, asset utilisation, and operational data, contributing to KPI frameworks, experiment design, and AI/ML use case development — using AI tools where they genuinely accelerate work, not as a default. This is an individual contributor role: your impact comes from analytical craft, clarity of thinking, and your ability to influence decisions through insight rather than through line management or product ownership. You will sit close to platform product and engineering teams, but your remit is analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Insight

Identify and quantify opportunities in platform data; translate findings into clear recommendations for product and business teams.
Design and maintain decision-oriented KPI frameworks accessible to front-line teams and senior management alike.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on product adoption, user behaviour, performance trends, and business impact — and design experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, significance testing) to test hypotheses that emerge.
Support benefit estimation and validation for platform product initiatives.

Data Craft & Self-Sufficiency

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, transform, and model data from multiple source systems.
Build reusable analytical datasets that support recurring analysis and reporting — working independently or alongside data engineering colleagues as needed.
Work within our Azure/Databricks cloud infrastructure, treating analytical datasets as data products: clear ownership, documented SLAs, versioning, and a feedback loop with end users.
Proactively identify data quality issues and work with upstream teams to resolve them.

Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery

Partner with product owners, Business users, and engineering teams to translate analytical needs into well-defined workstreams and communicate findings through data storytelling that connects insight to business priorities and drives action.
Own your analytical backlog — prioritise, set realistic expectations, and manage delivery independently.
Flag potential bias, fairness issues, or unintended consequences in analytical outputs and model inputs before they reach decisions.

AI/ML & GenAI

Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks that enable AI/ML model development.
Use tools like Copilot (code completion) and Claude or ChatGPT (summarisation, documentation, data exploration) to accelerate analytical tasks — anchored to specific, validated workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure analytical outputs meet model input requirements (schema, distribution, data quality).

Skills & Experience

Education

Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3–6 years in business analytics or data analysis, ideally in a complex, large-scale data environment.
Proven track record delivering end-to-end analytical projects — from scoping through to stakeholder action.
Experience working in or alongside product or platform teams.
Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, LLM-based analysis, prompt engineering) as part of analytical or engineering workflows is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL proficiency for extraction, transformation, and modelling across large datasets.
Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation (pandas, numpy, and similar libraries).
Azure and Databricks experience; familiarity with data pipeline development, data modelling concepts, and data quality best practices.
Power BI or equivalent, with the ability to build clear, decision-oriented dashboards.
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and how analytical pipelines feed into model development; practical use of AI coding tools (Copilot) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for analytical tasks — with the judgement to validate outputs and know their limits.

Behaviours & Mindset

Proactive and self-directed — you identify problems before being asked and take ownership.
Structured problem-solver — you break ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical tasks and communicate findings to diverse audiences without losing rigour.
Collaborative and stakeholder-savvy — you understand that great analytics only creates value when trusted and acted upon, and balance high standards with pragmatism about what fits the decision at hand.
AI-critical — you use GenAI tools effectively but validate outputs, flag governance concerns, and apply your own judgement before acting on recommendations.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

LI-MG1

 

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Title: ID Power Algo Trader – AAL/CPH/SG
Description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

We are currently looking for a technically strong, analytically rigorous trader with deep experience in continuous markets and real-time modelling. This pivotal role calls for a seasoned professional who combines strong trading intuition with advanced statistical and programming capabilities, and who can translate ambiguous problems into structured models that drive PnL.




As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the performance and evolution of our intraday power trading activities. This position requires analytical depth, strong decision-making under uncertainty, and a deep understanding of market structure, pricing mechanics, and liquidity dynamics. You must be comfortable operating in real-time environments, adapting to shifting market conditions, and continuously improving models and systems to enhance predictive accuracy and trading outcomes. Collaboration is central to success in this role; therefore, the ability to work seamlessly across trading and engineering teams is essential to optimizing strategies, improving infrastructure, and scaling automated decision-making.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop fair value models for intraday power markets
Implement algorithms to integrate models with market dynamics to inform trading strategy
Compile high-quality datasets to integrate fundamental and real-time market data
Monitor and adjust model parameters in response to shifting market conditions, liquidity regimes, or evolving trading situations
Identify model limitations, edge cases, and structural risks, and proactively address them
Collaborate with engineering to optimize operations, enhance infrastructure, and scale automated decision-making




QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, possession of a PhD will be considered an advantage.
A minimum of 3 years' experience is required
Extensive experience with continuous trading, whether in prediction markets, betting platforms, crypto, or traditional markets
Expertise in predictive modelling and machine learning, with a focus on time-series analysis.
Ability to articulate model assumptions, and real-world edge cases.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep working knowledge of the data and machine learning ecosystem.
Experience in a statically typed programming language is a plus
Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of additional languages will be viewed favourably.




WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Pathways for professional growth and career development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.
Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.

Title: Statistician
Place: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
CMC PAT & Statistics

Måløv, Denmark, On-site

Start your career where new medicines and new ways of working are created.

Are you about to begin your career in applied statistics? Would you like to learn from experienced statisticians while working on some of Novo Nordisk's newest drug development projects?

In this role, you won't be maintaining established processes you'll help support the statistical work behind products, processes and analytical methods that are still being developed. You'll join a team of highly experienced statisticians who will coach and support you as you build your technical expertise and understanding of pharmaceutical development.

Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure

Hold a Master within a quantitative field
You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

You must be a strong team player

You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo
You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer

Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues
The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team's development
A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!

Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.




Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Title: PhD scholarship in “Hearing loss phenotyping for vascular and dementia risk stratification” - DTU Health Tech
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you interested in combining audiology, data science, and epidemiology to understand how hearing loss relates to brain health and dementia?

The Hearing Systems Section at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), together with collaborators from the Copenhagen Hearing and Balance Centre (CHBC), Rigshospitalet, invite applications for a 3-year PhD position as part of the VERA project (Vascular Effects on the Risk of Age-related Hearing Loss and Dementia). This position is part of an international Alliance PhD programme between DTU and the University of Queensland (UQ), Australia.

Age-related hearing loss is strongly associated with cognitive decline and dementia, but the mechanisms underlying this relationship remain unclear. A key limitation in existing research is that hearing loss is typically treated as a single, homogeneous condition. This PhD project addresses this gap by decomposing hearing loss into biologically meaningful components - in particular metabolic and sensory-dominated patterns - and evaluating how these relate to vascular disease burden and dementia risk.

You will work with large-scale Danish clinical and audiological datasets, with the possibility to link these to national health registries and hearing intervention records. A central focus of the project is the development and validation of hearing loss phenotypes using computational modelling approaches. These model-based indicators may be evaluated and refined through complementary analyses, including comparisons with physiological and electrophysiological measures such as otoacoustic emissions (OAE) and frequency-following responses (FFR), where relevant data are available or can be collected. Building on this validation framework, the project will investigate how different hearing loss phenotypes relate to variation in vascular health, cognitive performance, and dementia risk across individuals.

The project is embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment spanning epidemiology, clinical audiology, auditory modelling, and cognitive neuroscience. You will join the Hearing Systems Section at DTU Health Tech and the Copenhagen Hearing and Balance Centre (CHBC) at Rigshospitalet. The project provides access to unique clinical and epidemiological datasets and offers a research stay at the University of Queensland in Australia with Professor Piers Dawes as part of the Alliance PhD programme.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

You will:


Develop and apply computational models to derive hearing loss phenotypes from clinical audiograms
Assess the robustness and validity of model-based phenotypes (e.g., stability, biological plausibility)
Analyse large-scale linked audiological and registry datasets
Evaluate associations between hearing loss components, vascular health, and dementia outcomes
Collaborate with clinicians, epidemiologists, and engineers across Denmark and Australia
Disseminate research findings through scientific publications and conferences


You should:


Have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree in biomedical engineering, neuroscience, data science, statistics, audiology, physics, computer science, or a related field
Have strong quantitative and analytical skills, for example within statistics, modelling, machine learning, or data science
Have experience with programming in Python, R, Matlab, or similar environments
Be interested in hearing science, audiology, epidemiology, vascular health, and dementia research
Be motivated to work with large and complex datasets
Enjoy working in a cross-disciplinary research field and be able to work independently
Communicate research effectively in English


Experience with audiology, epidemiology, registry data, neuroscience, or modelling of biological systems is advantageous but not required.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree. [AAK2]

Approval and Enrolment

The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education .

Assessment

The assessment of the applicants will be made by Associate Professor Abigail Anne Kressner and relevant members of the project team.

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years.

The starting date is as soon as possible and at latest 1 Dec 2026. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Abigail Anne Kressner (PI), aakress@dtu.dk .

You can read more about DTU Health Tech at www.healthtech.dtu.dk and about the Clinical and Technical Audiology research group at https://www.healthtech.dtu.dk/research/research-sections/section-hearing-systems/group-clinical-and-technical-audiology .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark . Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “ PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar ” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 27 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time), but applications will be processed as they come in.

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:


A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
Curriculum vitae
Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale


You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The host institution is the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Health Technology, within the Technical University Hospital of Greater Copenhagen (TUH) framework, and the project will be conducted in close collaboration with the Copenhagen Hearing and Balance Centre (CHBC) at Rigshospitalet, Greater Copenhagen University Hospital. The research group operates across both institutions, with an approximately equal presence at DTU and CHBC, ensuring continuous integration of research and clinical practice.

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Title: PhD scholarship in Machine Learning in Computational Immunology - DTU Health Tech
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about science and developing and applying machine learning (ML) methodology to study the immune system and associated autoimmune disease states and mechanisms?

Then you may be the perfect candidate for this fully funded PhD Scholarship!

The Computational Autoimmunity group at the Technical University of Denmark, is looking for a highly motivated computational scientist with a strong foundation in bioinformatics and advanced ML. This PhD position offers the opportunity to push the boundaries of our understanding of Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) using ML driven immune modelling in a close clinical collaboration with the leading hospital in Copenhagen, Rigshospitalet. You will gain invaluable experience in augmenting and combining your technical skillset with concrete real-world application to patient data aiming to better the life of patients for the benefit of society.

Research Focus, Responsibilities And Qualifications

Your focus will be on developing and applying machine learning methods to study immune mechanisms in Type 1 Diabetes. Specifically, you will investigate disease-relevant spatial organisation of immune cells in patient samples and develop computational approaches for identifying T-cell receptor (TCR) sequence and repertoire patterns associated with disease.

The project combines large-scale public immune repertoire data with spatial transcriptomics data generated in close collaboration with Rigshospitalet. A central ambition is to bridge immune repertoire analysis and spatial transcriptomics, linking TCR-level molecular patterns with spatially resolved tissue context. The project is therefore methodologically driven, while embedded in a translational research setting with direct relevance to autoimmune disease biology.

Your primary tasks will be to:


Develop, benchmark, and apply ML methodology for pattern recognition in immune repertoire and spatial transcriptomics data
Integrate heterogeneous public and project-specific datasets
Interpreting computational results in close collaboration with clinical partners
Communice findings through scientific publications and presentations at international conferences


Required Qualifications

You must have:


A two-year Master’s degree (120 ECTS) in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, or a closely related field
Strong passion for science and expanding human knowledge through research to make a difference
Strong programming skills in R and/or Python
Experience with machine learning and statistics
Experience working with biological sequence and omics data
Excellent written and spoken English


You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills and experience are a strong match for the role.

Approval and Enrolment

The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education .

Assessment

Title: Industrial PhD candidate in fibro-metabolic osteoarthritis: blood-based molecular endotyping
Place: Herlev, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about osteoarthritis, biomarker science and precision medicine? Do you thrive at the interface of biomarkers, bioinformatics, and clinical research, and do you enjoy combining computational discovery with hands-on biomarker work in the laboratory?

The position

We are looking for a PhD candidate for a 3-year industrial PhD fellowship at Nordic Bioscience (Herlev, Denmark), co-funded by Innovation Fund Denmark, conducted in collaboration with The Parker Institute (Frederiksberg Hospital, Denmark). The project aims to define a new fibro-metabolic endotype of osteoarthritis (OA) and to develop blood-based biomarker signatures that can guide metabolic and weight-targeted treatment of osteoarthritis in patients with overweight.

This is a predominantly computational role. Approximately 75% of your time will be spent on data science, bioinformatics, biostatistics and machine learning, and approximately 25% on organizing and conducting laboratory work, where you contribute to the measurement of the serum biomarkers that feed the analyses.

Project and responsibilities

Osteoarthritis affects an estimated 600 million people worldwide, and obesity and metabolic dysfunction are key modifiable drivers of disease. You will test whether patients with elevated fibro-metabolic biomarkers define distinct fibro-metabolic subtypes of disease, with its own biology, symptoms, trajectories and treatment response, particularly to metabolic and weight-loss interventions such as GLP-1 receptor agonists. You will work across both observational and interventional studies to build the data foundation, discover and characterise the endotype, and demonstrate its clinical actionability.

Key contributions:

Build and curate a harmonised, multi-study biomarker and clinical OA database, including quality control of serum biomarker measurements across cohorts and trials
Discover and characterise a fibro-metabolic OA endotypes using clustering and explainable machine learning, integrating novel tissue turnover biomarkers and clinical data
Assess their relevance in clinical trials. Perform statistical analysis in clinical cohorts
Write and publish peer-reviewed scientific papers
Present and promote your research at international conferences, meetings and with stakeholders

As a PhD fellow at Nordic Bioscience, you are expected to manage and conduct your research project in collaboration with your supervisors, across departments, and partners at Parker Institute. You will take PhD courses relevant for the project, participate in national and international congresses and scientific meetings to disseminate your research, write scientific articles, engage in laboratory biomarker work (≈25% of your time), and contribute to project execution activities.

Your Background

The candidate must hold a relevant MSc degree (bioinformatics, biostatistics, data science, biomedical engineering, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmaceutical science, medicine or alike), have a grade of at least 10 (or equivalent for foreign educations) in the MSc thesis, and achieve one of these two requirements for grade-point averages:

Master's and bachelor's degree combined: weighted average of at least 8.2 on the 7-point scale
For a two-year master's degree alone: weighted average of at least 9.5 on the 7-point scale

Qualifications and key criteria for assessment

The grades achieved during bachelor/master studies
Demonstrated experience and interest in bioinformatics, biostatistics and/or machine learning (e.g. R or Python, clustering, regression, mixed-effects models)
Willingness and interest to in engaging in laboratory biomarker work (≈25% of the project)
Interest or knowledge in the field of osteoarthritis, rheumatology or metabolic disease
Knowledge of clinical study design and the analysis of clinical studies is an advantage
Fluency in English (spoken and written)
Collaborative mindset and able to work as part of a research team
Relevant work experience

About the Department

The PhD student will be affiliated with the Rheumatology / ImmunoScience team at Nordic Bioscience, working closely with the company's Data Science group. The group develops novel blood-based biomarkers of extracellular matrix remodelling that detect early disease activity and treatment response, enabling more effective and personalised patient care. The team collaborates closely with world-leading academic and clinical partners, and high scientific quality, publication output and international conference presence are central to our culture.

Working at Nordic Bioscience

Nordic Bioscience is a science-driven research and development company that aims at providing precision medicine for the future and strong academic environment with more than 30 PhD and post.docs employed. We strive to foster excellence, innovation, and data-driven decision-making in an environment where new inventions and high-quality products go hand in hand with due diligence and reliability. We are motivated by data that provides support of promising new drugs or new hope for better patient care. We off a collaborative environment with engaged colleagues in a growing company making a global fingerprint.

Contact

For further details please contact Christian Thudium, mailto:cst@nordicbio.com.

How to apply

Please apply via our online application system. Please upload the following documents for the application:

Cover letter
Full CV (max 2 pages), including a list of publications
Diploma and transcripts of records: master's degree diploma (including grade transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees). Applicants with a master's degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used.
Letters of recommendation from relevant and appropriate referees, or the names and contact details of referees (e.g. former supervisors/PIs).
For applicants whose principal language of instruction during their BSc/MSc was not English or Danish, it is an advantage to include IELTS or TOEFL test scores or equivalent proof of English skills.

Deadline for application is 6 September 2026. Interviews will be conducted ongoingly based on incoming applications. So please send your application as soon as possible.

Title: Principal AI Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications


At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.
Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.
Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.
Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.
Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.
Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.


What you will do


Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.
Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.
Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.
Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.
Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.
Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.
Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices
Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.


What we offer


A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.
A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.
A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.
A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.
A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.
A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.
Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.


How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Title: Scientist, Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology (PK/PD Modeling & Simulation)
Description:
Join Hemab, a clinical-stage biotech company, on an exciting journey to build the ultimate clotting company. We focus on addressing the high unmet needs of patients suffering from rare bleeding and thrombotic disorders. With offices in Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark, Hemab cultivates a vibrant, agile and forward-thinking environment where collaboration, innovation, and high-quality biotherapeutics development go hand in hand.

As a Scientist, PK/PD Modeling & Simulation, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying population PK, PK/PD, exposure–response and QSP models to support model-informed drug development across Hemab’s pipeline. You will work closely with internal cross-functional leads (clinical pharmacology, nonclinical, clinical development, biometrics, regulatory and quality) and external collaborators (CROs and consultants) to provide quantitative insights that inform dose selection, clinical study design, and regulatory filings. Your work will be central to integrating modeling and simulation strategies into Hemab’s clinical programs and advancing our mission to deliver first-in-class therapies to patients with rare bleeding disorders.

At Hemab, we foster an environment where everyone can wear multiple hats depending on their experience, fit, and motivation to get things done. We constantly strive to celebrate our achievements collectively and gather feedback to continuously sustain and improve our fast-paced, cross-functional work environment.




What you'll do at Hemab?

Develop, validate, and execute population PK, PK/PD exposure–response, PBPK and QSP models to support dose selection, regimen optimization, and trial design.
Perform simulations to inform early clinical study design, establish clinical proof-of-concept (PoC), and guide pivotal program decisions.
Analyze preclinical and clinical PK/PD data, translating insights into actionable recommendations for clinical teams.
Contribute quantitative components for regulatory submissions (INDs, CTAs, BLAs) and respond to agency questions on modeling and simulation deliverables.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure modeling insights are integrated into development plans and communicated clearly to stakeholders.
Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and new quantitative methods to continuously improve modeling strategies and workflows.
Support vendor and consultant selection and management to ensure high-quality, timely deliverables for modeling and simulation activities.

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
HTML:
Do you want to help clients create value in a deal (M&A) context using AI? Do you want to work on high-impact problems across due diligence, valuation, integration, separation, and post-deal value creation? Do you enjoy building practical solutions using modern AI tools and techniques, while working closely with deal teams and clients? Does it appeal to you to turn ambiguous business challenges into working products and workflows at speed? Then apply immediately!


What does your work look like?

As a Deals AI Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting, analytics, and industry experience, helping our clients address complex business issues across the deal lifecycle. You will be embedded in deal teams where AI is playing an increasingly important role in how we generate insight, improve workflows, and create value for clients.


You will work closely with Deals professionals and clients to identify opportunities where AI can solve real business problems. The work involves designing, building, and deploying bespoke solutions using a range of modern technologies, including Python, MCPs, APIs, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic patterns, and other AI tools and frameworks. You will focus not on theory for its own sake, but on applying the right techniques to solve practical problems in fast-moving deal environments.


In your daily job, your tasks will be the following:

  • Designing, building, and iterating AI-powered tools, workflows, and applications for live deal and value-creation contexts;
  • Working across the full solution cycle: problem framing, prototyping, testing, deployment, and refinement;
  • Communicating technical ideas and outputs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including clients and senior deal professionals;
  • Identifying and addressing client and deal team problems where AI can create meaningful value;
  • Working with the broader deal team (including financial due diligence, valuation and modelling, carve-out and integration, etc.) to incorporate AI-enabled solutions into the wider PwC offering;
  • Contributing to internal innovation projects, helping identify reusable patterns, improve current ways of working, and build knowledge around new AI techniques and tools;


You will get the chance to be part of a growing team in one of the most successful Deals (M&A) practices in the market. You will work in multidisciplinary deal teams consisting of colleagues with different backgrounds and expertise, in which you are responsible for designing and delivering AI-enabled solutions. You will work on projects for both corporate and private equity clients, giving you unique exposure to Danish and international businesses and to the practical application of AI in high-value situations.


Who are you?

Your Passion Is To Build Technology That Solves Real Business Challenges While Working In a Dynamic Environment. You Are Curious By Nature, Enjoy Learning New Tools And Techniques, And Are Motivated By Turning Ideas Into Working Solutions. You Are Comfortable Working Hands-on In Code, But Also Enjoy Understanding The Commercial Value Behind The Technical Task.


Furthermore

  • You have relevant education and experience in applied AI in a business context, technical consulting and equivalent, or have a background in business and economics with a strong technical foundation;
  • You have strong hands-on programming skills, especially in Python, and experience working with APIs, testing, version control, and modern deployment practices;
  • You have practical experience with AI technologies such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, AI agents, or similar tools and techniques;
  • You are comfortable building prototypes quickly and refining them based on user needs and feedback;
  • You can communicate concisely technical concepts and AI-driven insights to non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders;
  • You are willing to learn about the commercial and financial side of Deals;
  • You are a team player and enjoy in-person interactions, but you are also naturally-driven and can work autonomously in a fast-moving environment;
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Danish is not a requirement but is an advantage;


We are recruiting across different grades, including Associate and Senior Associate, and welcome candidates with varying levels of experience who can demonstrate strong technical foundations, curiosity, a practical problem-solving mindset and a passion to apply that to answer commercially-relevant questions.


What do we offer?

We are passionate about what we do and who we work with. We will devote much attention to your personal and technical development. Next to access to internal and external training, there is also an important element of learning on the job to develop your data analytics capabilities. Furthermore, you will get a coach who will help you with your development throughout your career.


The Danish Deals team also works together with PwC Deals teams in the Nordic region as well as globally. International opportunities therefore can become part of your career development.


Grow here. Go further.

As part of PwC, you will join a market success and a friendly workplace. Between the two trust emerges, careers develop, and you and your colleagues will create innovative solutions for the businesses and society that we are all a part of.


Do you want to be part of our strong community?

Submit your CV, university transcripts, and answers to the questions below (each answer should be no more than five sentences). Please upload all documents using the same upload button.


Questions

  • Describe one AI or technical solution you built that solved a real business problem. What was your role and what was the outcome?
  • Give one example of a Deals (M&A) problem where AI could create value. What would make it a strong use case in practice?

Description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Join Us as a Safety Scientist III – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in patient safety. As a Safety Scientist III, you will be responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of signal detection and product safety scientist activities, with a focus on tasks that are low to high in complexity or which concern low to high complexity products. Additionally, you will support the mentoring of more junior colleagues, the development of processes, tools, and systems, and may serve as lead on smaller FSP-type projects.

Roles And Responsibilities


Support strategies for safety data generation, assessment, and communications by regular interactions with Safety Evidence Leads and other stakeholders across the organization world-wide, to gather information on topics to be analysed and present findings at internal meetings.
Synthesize contributions from multiple sources of data into meaningful insights in order to demonstrate product(s) value.
Monitor competitive environment for new safety information, and compares to safety information of our product(s), thus supporting differentiation activities.
In collaboration with Safety Evidence Leads and other stakeholders such as Biostatistics and Digital Technology, establish safety evidence information platforms/dashboards and oversees regular updates. Identify areas for innovation including AI/machine learning and similar.
Conduct data mining activities on regular basis to identify data gaps, and communicate safety findings promptly.
Ensure reproducibility and traceability of analyses through structured workflows and version control.
Maintain documentation of data extraction and analyses.
Assist in the design, execution, and reporting of pharmacoepidemiologic studies to address specific safety questions.
Attends relevant internal and external meetings for training, competitor intelligence, and collaboration with KOLs and other experts.


Skills And Competencies


5+ years of experience in data analysis to understand complex linkages of safety data from various sources, preferably in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare setting. Experience working with safety databases required, experience with large healthcare datasets (e.g., EHR, claims, registry data) is a plus
Proficiency in data extraction from the safety database (e.g. Argus Safety) and generating data insights using adequate digital tools.
Ability to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans, especially cross-functionally, through technological tools (e.g. GenAI, Copilot, automation tools, etc.) without compromising clinical integrity.


Education, Experience And Qualifications


Degree in Data Science, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Public Health, Computer Science, or a related field.
Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI, safety signal tools such as E
Empirica, or cloud-based data platforms. Proficiency in statistical programming languages (e.g., R, SAS, Python) is a plus.
Minimum of 5 years working in pharmaceutical/biotech industry.
Experience in regulated environments (both GCP and GVP).
Experience in RWE generation, pharmacoepidemiology and/or rare disease is a plus.
Ability to travel up to 20% of time as needed.


Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Title: Clinical Analytics Engineer - Digital Solutions
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Clinical Analytics Engineer – Digital Solutions

Do you enjoy solving complex challenges at the intersection of clinical development, data and technology? Are you motivated by building digital solutions that help bring innovative treatments to patients? Then you could be our next Clinical Analytics Engineer in Digital Solutions.

Your new role

As a Clinical Analytics Engineer, you will play an important role in enabling data-driven clinical development across Global Clinical Development.

You will design and develop data products, digital applications and data visualizations powered by Lundbeck's Clinical Data Foundation, enabling colleagues to access trusted insights throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. Partnering with colleagues across Global Clinical Development, you will translate business needs into digital solutions that support the planning, execution and monitoring of clinical trials.

As Digital Solutions expands its capabilities in data, analytics and AI, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the responsible adoption of AI across clinical development, helping translate emerging technologies into practical solutions that support clinical development, while working in a highly regulated GxP environment where quality and compliance are fundamental.

Together with colleagues across Global Clinical Development, you will transform trusted clinical data into digital capabilities that create value across the global clinical development organization.

Your future team

Digital Solutions is part of the Data Management, Programming & Digital Solutions division within Global Clinical Development.

You will join a team of highly skilled and engaged colleagues who are passionate about using data, technology, and innovation to improve clinical development. As Lundbeck continues to advance its pipeline and run more complex clinical trials, our mission is to enable data-driven clinical development by delivering digital products, analytics and AI capabilities that help colleagues make the best use of trusted clinical data.

Our culture is collaborative, curious, and pragmatic. We enjoy tackling complex challenges together, sharing knowledge and continuously learning from one another. We value ownership, trust and experimentation, believing the best solutions emerge when diverse perspectives come together around a common purpose.

The position is based in Valby, Denmark.

What You Bring To The Team

Whether you already have several years of experience or are an exceptional recent graduate with the right technical foundation and mindset, you are eager to learn, collaborate and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

We imagine that you bring:


Strong SQL skills together with experience in one or more programming languages such as Python, R or SAS. Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering technologies such as Snowflake, AWS, dbt, Dagster and Fivetran, or similar technologies, is an advantage.
Experience developing analytical applications, data products and data visualizations. Experience with Spotfire, JavaScript frameworks (e.g. Vue.js), Dash/Plotly, or similar frontend technologies is an advantage.
An understanding of clinical development or healthcare data, together with an appreciation of working within a regulated GxP environment where data quality, compliance and patient safety are essential. Familiarity with CDISC SDTM is considered a plus.
A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills and curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI, and how they can be applied responsibly to improve clinical development.



Our promise to you

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

Annual base salary range: (491 000 - 675 400) DKK gross

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

Apply now

Title: Data Science - Manager - Retail
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

As a Manager for Data Science consulting, you operate at the intersection of business strategy, data, and emerging AI technologies. You work closely with clients to shape their data and AI agendas—translating business challenges into actionable opportunities, advising on the right approaches, and guiding initiatives from idea through to value realization.

You bring a strong technical foundation, but your primary focus is on understanding client needs, framing problems, and designing impactful solutions. You are a trusted advisor who can connect strategy, data, technology, and organizational change—while staying hands-on enough to explore data, prototype solutions, and leverage modern AI tools.

Qualifications


Strong experience in data, AI, or analytics roles, with exposure to both technical implementation and business-facing work
Proven ability to engage clients, structure problems, and translate business needs into data/AI solutions
Proven experience in developing and deploying AI models at scale, including natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and reinforcement learning.
Expertise in machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn, as well as experience with cloud-based AI platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Strong understanding of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines and big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, SQL, and NoSQL.
Experience working with modern AI ecosystems (e.g., cloud platforms, LLMs, AI tools, or data platforms)
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, exploring new problem spaces, and expanding into adjacent domains
Demonstrated curiosity and eagerness to learn and apply new technologies, especially within the rapidly evolving AI landscape
Experience in consulting, digital transformation, or cross-functional environments is a strong plus


Additional Information

Set Yourself Apart With


Experience defining AI or data strategies for organizations
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools (e.g., generative AI, copilots, automation platforms)
Exposure to data architecture, data engineering, or product development
Track record of driving AI adoption or innovation initiatives within organizations
Advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., data science, engineering, business, or similar)


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:


Equally comfortable in the boardroom and with a dataset
A translator between business ambition and technical reality
Curious, adaptable, and excited about the fast-moving AI landscape
Motivated to go beyond pure data science into broader problem-solving and innovation


Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of the next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Title: Open Talent Pool - all DHI locations
Place: Hørsholm, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At DHI, water, environment and sustainability meet innovation. Join us in enabling a sustainable future for water!

Looking to make an impact on our planet? At DHI, you can. We work with water in all its forms – combining deep domain knowledge, advanced digital technology, and more than 60 years of research and innovation to help society use, manage and live with water sustainably. With over 1,100 engineers and specialists across 26 countries, we are continually expanding our global community of experts.

As we grow, new opportunities emerge throughout the year. Even when a specific vacancy isn’t yet published, we welcome proactive applications from individuals who want to contribute to our mission – including senior specialist with years of experience or students, recent graduates and early career professionals who are excited to build their future in the water sector.

Why submit an open application?

Our business evolves quickly, and new roles – technical, scientific, digital and business-oriented – are created as projects grow and priorities shift. Submitting an open application adds you to our Open Talent Pool, enabling us to reach out when a suitable opportunity arises, often before it is advertised.

Before you submit your open application, please make sure to check our current vacancies as well.

Opportunities for Students & Early Career Talent

We strongly encourage students and early career professionals to apply.

At DHI, You Can


Join as an intern, student assistant, thesis collaboration partner or industry master program student
Contribute to global water projects alongside experienced specialists
Apply your academic knowledge to real-world environmental and digital challenges
Grow your skills in engineering, modelling, climate resilience, data science, software development, sustainability and more
Work in a culture that supports experimentation, learning and exploration


If you are studying or recently graduated in engineering, environmental science, climate studies, digital technology, or related fields – and want to help shape a sustainable future – your application is very welcome.

Profiles we are interested in

We invite applications from experienced professionals, graduates, and students with interest or expertise in:


Engineering & Environmental Science Coastal, marine, environmental, hydraulic, climate, civil, ecosystem modelling
Data, Digital & Technology Software development, data science, machine learning, AI, digital product development
Consulting & Project Delivery Advisory services, modelling, client engagement, project/programme management
Sustainability & ESG
Corporate Functions Legal, compliance, HR, finance, operations, commercial roles


We value cross disciplinary thinkers—if your background doesn’t fit into a category, we still encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

When you join DHI, you are empowered to be an explorer—to innovate, collaborate, and continuously learn. You’ll be part of a global organisation committed to protecting water ecosystems and developing sustainable solutions for communities, cities, industries and the planet.

Positions May Be


Fulltime or parttime
Based in various global locations or open to flexible arrangements
Project based or permanent, depending on organisational needs


How To Apply


Please submit your application through our careers page under “Open Talent”. If you are interested in other locations, please indicate that clearly.


Kindly Attach


Your CV
A brief note outlining your area of interests, skills and how you found DHI
List your preferred DHI location(s)
Links to portfolio, publications, or project work (optional)


Learn more about DHI www.dhigroup.com

Title: Energy forecast consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to have a direct influence on the forecasting accuracy of 15% of the whole world’s installed renewable power and contribute to the green energy transition? Would you like to learn about electricity markets, renewable energies, power forecasting and energy trading? Do you want to work in a company where you can have a direct impact on its growth and with a flat structure where your voice is heard? Would you like to join a team among the best in their field utilizing machine learning for creating solutions for the energy markets? If the answer is yes, read below!




ENFOR A/S is a world leading provider of forecasting and optimization solutions for the evolving energy industry. Our solutions utilize advanced machine learning and applied statistics to address weather-driven energy transition issues. We serve energy companies on six continents in more than 35 countries. Our services include forecasting of renewable energy production (from wind, solar and hydro), which is used by energy traders, big international energy companies and system operators all over the world. In addition, we also offer electricity consumption and price forecasts. As we are currently experiencing an increase in demand for our services, we are looking to hire Energy forecast Consultants to help design, implement and support power forecasting solutions for our clients. ENFOR A/S provides a stable, growing environment that values and invests in its employees to become world-leading experts in renewable energy and energy demand forecasting and how it relates to emerging and established energy markets.




Areas of responsibility

Serve as subject matter expert for new and existing customers to analyze and clarify needs and requirements, as well as performing data analysis of the customer’s data.
Design and configure forecasting and optimization software solutions for customers – sometimes leading projects and sometimes supporting peers.
Provide customer support for operational forecasting systems – ensuring that the systems operate effectively and with precision.
Identify, develop and implement tools to improve the efficiency of our systems and processes. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the implementation of AI tools and help.
shape how the team applies them in daily work.
Work closely with Sales, IT and Development teams by providing technical expertise and feedback as well as introducing new software features to client installations.




The ideal candidate

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, energy, physics, meteorology, data science, IT, mathematics/statistics or similar field.
Experienced in computer programming and knowledge about languages such as Python, R and Bash, as well as git for version control.
Good organization or project management skills. Demonstrated ability to manage working on multiple projects at the same time without losing track of important details.
Good written and spoken communication skills. Ability to communicate technical ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Takes initiative, drives and seeks continuous improvements both on the personal level as well as for the company.
Strives at delivering high quality, and at the same time understands the importance of delivering results, finalize projects and find pragmatic solutions to complex problems.
Has a flexible attitude, understanding various cultures and that the customers do not always know what they want and how to achieve what they need.
Fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.




We offer

An interesting client-facing job, where you will become part of a company with highly advanced and market leading solutions which support the green transition.
A comprehensive and well-developed training program which include sessions with subject experts.
An environment whereby you can develop your communication, programming and project management skills.
As a smaller company, you will have the opportunity to shape your own role and future within the company and make an impact on the development of the company and its solutions.
Social and professional company-wide events, held in person at the Copenhagen office.
Good opportunities for personal and professional development in an international environment.
Becoming part of a highly skilled team, which are among the best in the world within its field.




Interested candidates are asked to send a CV and a short cover letter.

For questions please contact:

Helena Charlotte Hansen, Head of Customer Forecasting Solutions, heh@enfor.dk

Title: Control and Simulation Specialist
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vestas Wind Systems A/S > Research & Development (R&D) > Plant Innovation

In the Plant Innovation department, innovative ideas within wind power plants are transformed into concepts that form the foundation for Vestas to maintain its leadership in innovation. We promote a working environment with a high degree of freedom to explore new concepts and a willingness to take on high technical risks, as failures are one of the sources of major innovations.

We are a team of diverse people with different technical competencies, educational backgrounds, and personal traits - we are very collaborative and encourage taking initiative.

You will get the opportunity to be involved in a vast number of different programming tasks and development of applications for simulations, data processing, analysis, and wind turbine, wind power plant and energy solution optimization.

Responsibilities


Propose and conduct innovative ideas within wind farm control, and wind power simulation
Develop and perform feasibility studies and technical assessments of new technologies supporting control and performance improvements in wind and hybrid power plants
Develop and apply AI/ML solutions, including use of AI agents, to support analysis, optimization, and decision support use cases
Design, build, and test prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions through direct programming, simulation, and experimental development
Execute and coordinate activities within a specific project, including documentation


Qualifications


Master's degree (or PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Energy Systems, Control Engineering, or a related technical field
Solid experience with wind farm/hybrid plant control, wind power simulation, or power plant modeling
Solid hands on experience in applied AI/ML development, AI based approaches for analysis, optimization, orchestration, or decision support applications
Demonstrated 5+ years of experience working with large-scale operational or industrial datasets, such as time series or SCADA-style data, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and performance evaluation
Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB, C/C++, including use of ML frameworks, data pipelines, and simulation environments


Competencies


Motivated and creative approach to bring new ideas to feasibility assessment and business case justification, including risks, and scalability potential
Experience with new technology development and comfortable operating in an innovation environment with technical uncertainty and risk
An effective collaborator who shares knowledge and supports the team
Self-motivated, results-focused, and accountable
Clear and concise communicator of technical results to both specialist and non specialist stakeholders
Fluent English communication skills, both spoken and written


What We Offer

We offer an opportunity to be part of a collaborative team supporting Vestas' mission for sustainability. You will be part of an innovative organization and can contribute to future directions with your innovative ideas supporting highly skilled, creative, and international team working in an agile environment. We offer an attractive compensation package based on your qualifications, quality professional and personal development opportunities at a global manufacturer of wind turbines.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, www.vestas.com/en/careers/job-openings.

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

Open Intelligence (OI) is one of WPP’s most strategic bets - a flagship data and AI initiative at the intersection of machine learning, advertising technology, and audience insight, built to power the next generation of media intelligence. To lead the next phase of development at the embedding and applied-AI layer of OI, we are hiring a Data Science Team Lead in Copenhagen.
